answer.pull.above-tier.bare.text: Dinah को खींचने के लिए तैयार काम मिला, पर उसमें से कोई भी आपके घोषित स्तर पर खरा नहीं उतरता
answer.pull.above-tier.bare.context: The one-line sentence pull prints when the bare form was asked, a column holds ready work, and the tier the caller declared is admitted for none of it. It is a separate key from answer.pull.empty.bare on purpose, because a caller reading the message alone has to be able to tell work standing above it from no work at all.

answer.pull.above-tier.named.text: Dinah को {upstream} में {destination} के लिए तैयार काम मिला, पर उसमें से कोई भी आपके घोषित स्तर पर खरा नहीं उतरता
answer.pull.above-tier.named.context: The one-line sentence pull prints when the named form was asked, a source holds ready work, and the tier the caller declared is admitted for none of it. {upstream} names the source column by its title, {destination} names the column the caller asked pull to land the card in. It is a separate key from answer.pull.empty.named on purpose, because a caller reading the message alone has to be able to tell work standing above it from no work at all.

answer.pull.empty.bare.text: Dinah को अभी ऐसा कोई कॉलम नहीं मिला जिसमें आप pull कर सकें
answer.pull.empty.bare.context: The one-line sentence the empty answer of pull prints when the bare form was asked and nothing qualifies. It is the answer the refusal table explicitly carves out as an answer rather than a refusal, and the cardless OK response carries the catalog key the head renders.

answer.pull.empty.named.text: Dinah को {upstream} में ऐसा कुछ तैयार नहीं मिला जिसे {destination} में ले जाया जा सके
answer.pull.empty.named.context: The one-line sentence the empty answer of pull prints when the named form was asked and the upstream column holds no ready card this pull may take, which since routes includes an upstream whose ready cards are all bound somewhere else. {upstream} names the upstream column by its title, {destination} names the column the caller asked pull to land the card in.

attachments.empty.context: Printed when `dinah list attachments` is asked about an entity that carries none. No table follows, and the call succeeds: an entity with nothing attached is an answer rather than a mistake.

attachments.header.context: The sentence above the table `dinah list attachments` prints, naming the entity the attachments hang from. {count} is how many that entity carries.

card.blocked.context: Printed under the card line when the card is blocked.

card.field.context: Printed under the card line for one field this workbench declares that the card carries a value for, one line per field, in declaration order. {field} is the declared key and {value} is what the card stores under it, both read off the store rather than written here, so both are machine vocabulary and neither is translated.

card.holder.context: Printed under the card line when somebody holds the card.

card.inapplicable.context: Printed by show under the card line for one level axis or declared key that does not apply to the card and that the card stores nothing for, naming the gating field and what the card stores under it. {field}, {gate} and {value} are read off the workbench and the card, so all three are machine vocabulary and none is translated.

card.inapplicable.stored.text: {field}: {stored}, रखा गया यद्यपि लागू नहीं, क्योंकि {gate} {value} है
card.inapplicable.stored.context: Printed on every surface that draws card lines, in place of the ordinary line for one level axis or declared key, when the card stores a value there that its applies_when condition no longer admits. {field} is the axis or key, {stored} is the kept value, {gate} is the gating field and {value} is what the card stores under it; all four are read off the workbench and the card and none is translated.

card.inapplicable.stored-unset.text: {field}: {stored}, रखा गया यद्यपि लागू नहीं, क्योंकि {gate} में कोई मान नहीं है
card.inapplicable.stored-unset.context: The sibling of card.inapplicable.stored printed when the card stores no value under the gating field at all. {field}, {stored} and {gate} are read off the workbench and the card and never translated.

card.inapplicable.unset.text: {field}: लागू नहीं, क्योंकि {gate} में कोई मान नहीं है
card.inapplicable.unset.context: The sibling of card.inapplicable printed when the card stores no value under the gating field at all. {field} and {gate} are read off the workbench and never translated.

card.line.context: The one line printed about a card after an act.

card.line.workstreams.context: The one line printed about a card that belongs to at least one workstream, after an act. It is card.line with the memberships on the end, and the caller chooses between the two by whether the card lists any. {workstreams} holds the workstreams already joined by card.line.workstreams.separator.

card.line.workstreams.separator.context: What separates two workstreams inside the {workstreams} field of card.line.workstreams. A punctuation mark and whatever spacing the language wants around it.

card.priority.context: Printed under the card line when the card carries a priority.

card.retirement-grant.context: Printed under the card line when the card carries a standing criterion-retirement authorization. {column} is the reference of the column the grant is bound to and {title} is that column's title; the reference is machine vocabulary and is never translated. A card carrying no grant draws no such line.

card.severity.context: Printed under the card line when the card carries a severity.

changes.cursor.context: The line printed under the events of `dinah changes`, carrying the token to hand back at the next call. {cursor} is that token, which a caller treats as opaque.

check.active-without-claim.text: कार्ड {detail} active है पर कोई धारक नहीं
check.active-without-claim.context: A check finding: the converse of the claim implication.

check.add.1.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.add.3.text: नामित कॉलम अपनी सीमा से नीचे है
check.add.3.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.add.4.text: वर्कबेंच हर नामित फ़ील्ड के लिए स्तर घोषित करती है
check.add.4.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.add.5.text: हर स्तर वह है जिसे वह फ़ील्ड घोषित करता है
check.add.5.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.applies-when-below-format.text: यह वर्कबेंच applies_when का उपयोग करती है पर फ़ॉर्मैट {detail} घोषित करती है; `dinah check --migrate-applies-when --yes` चलाएँ ताकि पुराना Dinah इसे गलत पढ़ने के बजाय अस्वीकार करे
check.applies-when-below-format.context: A check finding: a workbench whose definition carries an applies_when member or a level axis in mapping form while declaring a storage format below the one that introduced them. {detail} carries the declared format number. An older Dinah reads such a levels block wrongly rather than incompletely, which is what the format number exists to prevent, and the command line inside the sentence is the repair and stays as it is.

check.applies-when-malformed.text: {detail} पर applies_when शर्त उपयोग योग्य नहीं है, इसलिए जिस घोषणा पर वह है, वह हर कार्ड पर लागू होती है
check.applies-when-malformed.context: A check finding: an applies_when member the reader refused. {detail} carries the level axis or the declared key it sits on and then, in parentheses, the reason token: unreadable, tier, reaches-beyond-cards, gate-undeclared, gate-off-cards or gate-conditioned. The condition is ignored, so the axis or the key applies to every card, and the repair is an edit to the workbench anchor. The sentence says declaration rather than field because the slot may be a level axis.

check.applies-when-value-unmatchable.text: {detail} पर applies_when शर्त ऐसा मान नामती है जो उसका द्वार-फ़ील्ड कभी धारण नहीं कर सकता
check.applies-when-value-unmatchable.context: A check finding: one value in a usable applies_when condition's is list that the gating field's declared type refuses, so no card can ever store it and none is ever admitted by it. {detail} carries the level axis or the declared key and then the value in parentheses. The rest of the condition stands, and the repair is an edit to the workbench anchor.

check.archive.1.text: संदर्भ किसी ऐसी इकाई तक पहुँचता है जिसे यह कमांड संग्रहीत कर सकता है
check.archive.1.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.archive.2.text: संग्रहीत होने वाले कॉलम में कोई कार्ड नहीं
check.archive.2.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.archive.3.text: वर्कबेंच में कम से कम एक कॉलम बना रहता है

check.archive.4.text: संचालक कार्य करता है, किसी कॉलम पर या किसी कॉलम या वर्कबेंच के संलग्नक पर
check.archive.4.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.at-loop-limit.text: कॉलम {detail} ऐसा loop_limit घोषित करता है जिस पर यह कार्ड पहले ही पहुँच चुका है, इसलिए इसकी अगली पीछे की चाल अस्वीकार की जाएगी
check.at-loop-limit.context: A check finding: the card standing at this column has left it backwards as often as the column's loop_limit allows. {detail} carries the declaring column.

check.attach.1.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.attach.2.text: निवेदन किसी स्वामी को नामता है
check.attach.2.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.attach.3.text: संदर्भ ऐसी किस्म को नामता है जो संलग्नक रखती है
check.attach.3.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.attach.4.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.attach.5.text: संचालक कार्य करता है, जहाँ फ़ाइल किसी कॉलम या वर्कबेंच पर जाती है
check.attach.5.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.attachment-filename-drift.text: संलग्नक {detail} की न्यासफ़ाइल का नाम उसके अंकर से अलग है
check.attachment-filename-drift.context: A check finding: an attachment's payload file and its anchor's filename field disagree, which is the residue of a crash between a rename's two writes or of a hand edit nobody noticed.

check.attachments-without-a-mount.text: {detail} में एक attachments निर्देशिका है, और Dinah {detail} पर कोई संलग्नक नहीं रखती, इसलिए उसके भीतर की फ़ाइलों तक कुछ नहीं पहुँचता
check.attachments-without-a-mount.context: A check finding: an attachments directory sitting below an entity of a kind that holds no attachments. {detail} names that kind, which is machine vocabulary and is never translated. The path beside the sentence is the directory itself, because the reader has to open it to decide what to do with the files. Dinah does not remove it, because the files belong to whoever attached them.

check.bare-workbench.text: {detail} पर रखी workbench.md किसी भी .dinah कंटेनर के बाहर है, इसलिए कोई खोज उसे नहीं पाती; dinah check --migrate-container {detail} के अंदर एक .dinah कंटेनर बनाता है और वर्कबेंच की अपनी फ़ाइलें उसमें ले जाता है, {detail} में बाकी सब जहाँ है वहीं रहता है
check.bare-workbench.context: A check finding: a directory carrying a workbench.md Dinah recognises as its own, sitting outside any container, which the containment rule means is no longer a workbench. {detail} carries that directory.

check.block-without-reason.text: कार्ड {detail} बाधित है पर कारण नहीं
check.block-without-reason.context: A check finding: every blocked card carries a reason.

check.block.1.context: One row of the ordered precondition list of block, quoted from section 6 of the core profile.

check.block.2.text: निवेदन किसी स्वामी को नामता है
check.block.2.context: One row of the ordered precondition list of block, quoted from section 6 of the core profile.

check.block.4.text: कार्ड किसी के पास नहीं है, या माँगने वाले के पास है
check.block.4.context: One row of the ordered precondition list of block, quoted from section 6 of the core profile.

check.branch-conflict.anchor-differs.text: {card} उस फ़ील्ड के लिए पहले से एक अलग मान रखता है
check.branch-conflict.anchor-differs.context: One row of the branch migration's conflict report: a card whose stored value for the declared field differs from the value its body carries, so the run cannot tell which of the two the operator meant. {card} carries the card's reference.

check.branch-conflict.two-headings.text: {card} उस शीर्षक को एक से अधिक बार रखता है
check.branch-conflict.two-headings.context: One row of the branch migration's conflict report: a card whose body carries the retired heading more than once, so the run cannot tell which of them is the value. {card} carries the card's reference.

check.branch-conflict.unreadable.text: {card} खुलता नहीं, इसलिए रन उसे पढ़ नहीं सका
check.branch-conflict.unreadable.context: One row of the branch migration's conflict report: a card whose anchor will not open, so the run cannot classify it and will not write a workbench it has not read whole. {card} carries the card's identifier.

check.branch-emptied.text: {card} ने ऐसी शीर्षक खोई जिसके नीचे कुछ नहीं था।
check.branch-emptied.context: One line of the branch migration's own report, naming a card that carried the retired heading with nothing beneath it. Such a card loses the heading and gains no value, so it is named rather than counted alone. {card} carries the card's reference.

check.branch-heading-in-body.text: {detail} अपने मुख्य भाग में अब भी वह वापस ली गई शीर्षक रखता है, जिसे इस भंडार का फ़ॉर्मैट कहता है कि एक घोषित फ़ील्ड में उठा लिया गया था
check.branch-heading-in-body.context: A check finding: a card whose body still carries the retired heading, on a workbench whose declared format says that heading was lifted into a declared field. {detail} carries the card's reference. A workbench declaring a lower format is not reported, because it has not been carried across the retirement and the heading is still its convention.

check.branch-lift.context: One line of the branch migration's own report, naming a card and the value the migration lifted out of its body into the declared field. {card} carries the card's reference and {branch} the value now stored under that field, both read off the store, so both are machine vocabulary and neither is translated.

check.branch-would-empty.text: {card} ऐसी शीर्षक खो देता जिसके नीचे कुछ नहीं है।
check.branch-would-empty.context: One line of the branch migration's preview, naming a card that carries the retired heading with nothing beneath it. A confirmed run would take the heading away and write no value. {card} carries the card's reference.

check.branch-would-lift.context: One line of the branch migration's preview, naming a card and the value a confirmed run would lift out of its body into the declared field. It is spelled apart from check.branch-lift because a preview writes nothing, and the same sentence under both would tell an operator a write had happened. {card} carries the card's reference and {branch} the value the body holds, both read off the store, so both are machine vocabulary and neither is translated.

check.branches-conflicted.one.text: कुछ नहीं लिखा गया, क्योंकि {count} कार्ड को पार नहीं ले जाया जा सकता:
check.branches-conflicted.one.context: The heading over the cards the classification refused, for exactly one card. A single one of them stops the run before any write, so the rows beneath name what has to be repaired before a second run completes.

check.branches-conflicted.other.text: कुछ नहीं लिखा गया, क्योंकि {count} कार्डों को पार नहीं ले जाया जा सकता:
check.branches-conflicted.other.context: The heading over the cards the classification refused, for any other number. A single one of them stops the run before any write, so the rows beneath name what has to be repaired before a second run completes.

check.branches-declared.context: The line the branch migration prints when it added the declaration for the key it lifted into. A workbench that already declared the key keeps its own declaration and this line is not printed. {field} carries the key, read off the store, so it is machine vocabulary and is never translated.

check.branches-emptied.one.text: {count} कार्ड से एक खाली शीर्षक हटाई गई:
check.branches-emptied.one.context: The heading over the cards that carried the retired heading with nothing beneath it, for exactly one card. Each loses the heading and gains no value, so they are named rather than counted alone.

check.branches-emptied.other.text: {count} कार्डों से एक खाली शीर्षक हटाई गई:
check.branches-emptied.other.context: The heading over the cards that carried the retired heading with nothing beneath it, for any other number. Each loses the heading and gains no value, so they are named rather than counted alone.

check.branches-lifted.one.text: {count} कार्ड में उठाने योग्य एक मान है।
check.branches-lifted.one.context: The line the branch migration prints for what its classification found to lift, for exactly one card. It reports the classification rather than the write, so it reads the same whether the run went on to write or stopped at a conflict.

check.branches-lifted.other.text: {count} कार्डों में उठाने योग्य मान हैं।
check.branches-lifted.other.context: The line the branch migration prints for what its classification found to lift, for any other number. A count of zero is a run that found no heading to lift, which is that run's own answer.

check.branches-preview.text: कुछ भी नहीं लिखा गया, क्योंकि इस रन के साथ कोई पुष्टि नहीं थी।
check.branches-preview.context: The first line the branch migration prints when it ran without the confirmation flag, so that a reader cannot take the counts below it for work that happened.

check.branches-stamped.context: The line the branch migration prints when it wrote the format number onto the workbench anchor, which is what says the retirement has happened here. {format} carries the number.

check.branches-untouched.one.text: {count} कार्ड में ऐसी कोई शीर्षक नहीं है।
check.branches-untouched.one.context: The line the branch migration prints for the cards its classification found nothing to do to, for exactly one card. It is printed beside the count above so that a run which classified nothing cannot read as a run which found nothing to do.

check.branches-untouched.other.text: {count} कार्डों में ऐसी कोई शीर्षक नहीं है।
check.branches-untouched.other.context: The line the branch migration prints for the cards its classification found nothing to do to, for any other number. It is printed beside the count above so that a run which classified nothing cannot read as a run which found nothing to do.

check.branches-would-empty.one.text: {count} कार्ड से एक खाली शीर्षक हटाई जाती:
check.branches-would-empty.one.context: The heading over the cards carrying the retired heading with nothing beneath it, in the branch migration's preview, for exactly one card.

check.branches-would-empty.other.text: {count} कार्डों से एक खाली शीर्षक हटाई जाती:
check.branches-would-empty.other.context: The heading over the cards carrying the retired heading with nothing beneath it, in the branch migration's preview, for any other number.

check.card-number-duplicate.text: {detail} एक ऐसा क्रमांक दावा करती है जिसे दूसरी पंक्ति भी दावा करती है, इसलिए क्रमांक से किया गया संदर्भ एक से अधिक कार्डों का उत्तर देता है
check.card-number-duplicate.context: A check finding: two or more lines of the card-number registry claim one number, which leaves the durable half of a card reference ambiguous. {detail} carries the line as stored, which is what a reader searches the file for. `dinah check --renumber --yes` repairs it, moving every later claimant.

check.card-number-in-frontmatter.text: {detail} के एंकर में अब भी क्रमांक कुंजी बनी है, ऐसी वर्कबेंच पर जिसकी रजिस्ट्री ही क्रमांक का घर है
check.card-number-in-frontmatter.context: A check finding: a card of a workbench declaring the registry's format that still carries a number key in its anchor, which the migration strips and nothing else writes. {detail} carries the card's identifier. `dinah check --migrate-numbers --yes` strips it.

check.card-number-malformed.text: {detail} रजिस्ट्री के व्याकरण में नहीं पढ़ी जाने वाली पंक्ति है, इसलिए वह न कोई क्रमांक दावा करती है और न किसी कार्ड को
check.card-number-malformed.context: A check finding: a line of card-numbers.txt that does not parse under the registry's grammar. {detail} carries the line verbatim, which is what a reader searches the file for. No marker repairs it; the operator rewrites the line by hand.

check.card-number-missing.text: {detail} की कार्ड-क्रमांक रजिस्ट्री में कोई पंक्ति नहीं है, इसलिए कोई क्रमांक उसे नामता नहीं
check.card-number-missing.context: A check finding: a card in either half of the collection that no line of the card-number registry claims. {detail} carries the card's identifier. A workbench still declaring the older format draws this for every card it holds, which is the flood that ends when `dinah check --migrate-numbers --yes` builds the registry.

check.card-number-renumbered.text: {detail} का क्रमांक बदल दिया गया, इसलिए जो संदर्भ किसी ने उसके पुराने क्रमांक के लिए लिखा है वह मिलना बंद कर देता है
check.card-number-renumbered.context: A check finding a number repair raises: the card left the run holding a number it did not arrive holding. The renumbered event on the card's journal says the same thing where history keeps it. {detail} carries the card's identifier.

check.card-number-repeated.text: {detail} एक ही कार्ड को नामती हुई दो या अधिक पंक्तियों में से एक है, इसलिए कार्ड एक से अधिक क्रमांकों का उत्तर देता है
check.card-number-repeated.context: A check finding: two or more lines of the card-number registry name one identifier, so one card holds two numbers. {detail} carries the line as stored, which is what a reader searches the file for. No marker repairs it, because choosing what a card is called is the operator's.

check.card-number-stranded.text: {detail} न किसी कार्ड को नामती है न किसी वापस किए गए क्रमांक को, इसलिए जिस क्रमांक का वह दावा करती है वह किसी के पास नहीं है

Deciding what a damaged file or a damaged record should become is a different piece of work from deciding what a line ending should be.

check.newline-conflict.unwritable.text: {path} लिखी नहीं जा सकी, इसलिए कुछ भी नहीं लिखा गया।
check.newline-conflict.unwritable.context: One row of the newline repair's refusal report: a destination whose rehearsed write failed, which is what the rehearsal exists to find. {path} carries the file. The rehearsal renames the file's own bytes back over it, so a failure here is the failure the confirmed run would meet.

check.newline-repair-unsupported.text: पंक्ति-अंत मरम्मत इस फ़़ाइल पर निर्णय नहीं करती, इसलिए यह ठीक वैसी ही छोड़ दी जाती है ({detail})
check.newline-repair-unsupported.context: A check finding: a workbench text file the newline repair refuses rather than guessing at. {detail} says which case, either that a file bearing one of the anchor names the format fixes does not round-trip through the anchor reader, or the frontmatter key whose shape the repair cannot re-render. Such a file need carry no carriage return at all, which is why this is not reported as a stored line ending; deciding what a damaged header should become is separate work from deciding what a line ending should be.

check.newline-rewrite-loose.one.text: इसमें {count} ऐसा कैरिज रिटर्न भी है जो पंक्ति-अंत नहीं है, और जिसे मरम्मत अछूता छोड़ देती है।
check.newline-rewrite-loose.one.context: The clause drawn under a destination that also carries a carriage return the repair does not touch, for exactly one. A carriage return not followed by a line feed is a character the prose meant to carry rather than a line ending, so it is reported and kept. The line is drawn only where the count is above zero.

check.newline-rewrite-loose.other.text: इसमें {count} ऐसे कैरिज रिटर्न भी हैं जो पंक्ति-अंत नहीं हैं, और जिन्हें मरम्मत अछूता छोड़ देती है।
check.newline-rewrite-loose.other.context: The same clause for any other number.

check.newline-rewrote-file.one.context: One destination a confirmed newline repair wrote, for exactly one stored line ending. It is drawn only for a file the run actually rewrote, so a busy file or one a partial failure did not reach keeps the preview's tense instead.

check.newline-rewrote-file.other.context: One destination a confirmed newline repair wrote, for any other number.

check.newline-would-rewrite-file.one.text: {path} में मरम्मत के लिए {count} संग्रहीत पंक्ति-अंत है।
check.newline-would-rewrite-file.one.context: One destination a newline preview found, for exactly one stored line ending. {path} is the file and {count} is what the file's own transform would remove. The tense is the file's rather than the run's, because a confirmed run can carry a destination it did not reach.

check.newline-would-rewrite-file.other.text: {path} में मरम्मत के लिए {count} संग्रहीत पंक्ति-अंत हैं।
check.newline-would-rewrite-file.other.context: One destination a newline preview found, for any other number. A count of zero cannot occur here, because a file with nothing to remove is not a destination.

check.newlines-busy.one.text: {count} फ़़ाइल व्यस्त थी और पुनः नहीं लिखी गई; उसे लेने के लिए यह फ़िर से चलाएँ।
check.newlines-busy.one.context: The line the newline repair prints for one file whose lock another process holds. A held lock is the one condition that does not stop the run: a lock is held for milliseconds, a run takes one per file across thousands of files, and several sessions work a busy workbench at once, so a run refusing over a transient lock would refuse most of the time.

check.newlines-busy.other.text: {count} फ़़ाइलें व्यस्त थीं और पुनः नहीं लिखी गईं; उन्हें लेने के लिए यह फ़िर से चलाएँ।
check.newlines-busy.other.context: The line the newline repair prints for any other number of files whose locks another process holds.

check.newlines-confirm.text: लिखने के लिए --yes के साथ फ़िर से चलाएँ।
check.newlines-confirm.context: The line a newline preview prints under what it would repair. It parts company with the two number repairs either side of it, which refuse without confirmation rather than previewing.

check.newlines-examined.one.context: The line the newline repair prints for the size of the set it read, for exactly one file. A sweep says how many files it walked, because a sweep that reports nothing and walked nothing reads the same as a clean store.

check.newlines-examined.other.context: The line the newline repair prints for the size of the set it read, for any other number. A count of zero is a run that found no text file to read, which is that run's own answer.

check.newlines-heading.context: The heading the newline repair prints for a confirmed run, which is the run that writes the repaired bytes.

check.newlines-nothing.context: The line the newline repair prints when no examined file stores a carriage return standing for a line ending. A second run of a repair that succeeded prints this, because the repair is idempotent by construction: a file is a destination exactly when its own transform changes it, and every transform answers bytes it would not change again.

check.newlines-preview.text: पंक्ति-अंत स्थानांतरण (पूर्वावलोकन)। नीचे दिया गया प्रत्येक गंतव्य उसी के अपने बाइट्स से पुनः लिखा गया, यह सिद्ध करने के लिए कि वह लिखा जा सकता है; सामग्री अपरिवर्तित है और गंतव्य का संशोधन समय अब है।
check.newlines-preview.context: The heading the newline repair prints when it was asked for without --yes. It says that the preview writes rather than claiming that nothing was written, because the preview does write: nothing short of performing the rename predicts whether the rename will be permitted, so the only way a preview can promise that the confirmed run will succeed is to rehearse each destination's write with that destination's own bytes.

cmd.serve.note.text: हर अनुरोध का उत्तर वर्कबेंच से वैसा ही दिया जाता है जैसी वह डिस्क पर है, उसी JSON में जिसमें हर दूसरी मशीनी सतह उत्तर देती है। यह वह पता छापता है जिस पर यह सुन रहा है, और रोके जाने तक चलता है। यह केवल लूपबैक इंटरफ़ेस पर सुनता है, कहीं और नहीं, और किसी अनुरोध से नहीं पूछता कि उसे किसने भेजा। अनुरोध Dinah-Actor हेडर में उस कर्ता का नाम देता है जिसके रूप में वह काम करता है, और जो अनुरोध कोई नाम नहीं देता वह उसके रूप में काम करता है जिसने dinah serve शुरू किया, जो सामान्यतः आप हैं। इसलिए इस मशीन की कोई भी प्रक्रिया जो इस पते तक पहुँच सकती है, चाहे वह किसी भी खाते से चल रही हो, आपके नाम पर इस वर्कबेंच पर काम कर सकती है। दूसरे खातों को बाहर रखने और इस मशीन से बाहर परोसने, दोनों के लिए प्रमाणीकरण चाहिए, जो इस कमांड में नहीं है।
cmd.serve.note.context: The note printed under the serve command's own help, after its summary. It says what the server answers with, that it listens on the loopback interface alone, that a request naming no actor acts as whoever started the server, and that any process or account on the machine can reach it because the command authenticates nobody. Dinah-Actor is an HTTP header name and dinah serve is a command, and both stay as they are.

cmd.verify.note.text: टिप्पणी को यह बताना चाहिए कि जाँच में क्या दिखा। Dinah खाली टिप्पणी अस्वीकार करता है, और ऐसी टिप्पणी भी अस्वीकार करता है जो मानदंड के अपने पाठ को शब्दशः दोहराती है। यह जाँच केवल शाब्दिक प्रतिध्वनि पकड़ती है: जो टिप्पणी मानदंड को दूसरे शब्दों में दोहराती है वह इसे पार कर जाती है और फिर भी कुछ नहीं कहती। `--owner operator` के साथ दर्ज किया गया मानदंड केवल संचालक तय करता है, और संचालक द्वारा कहा गया परिणाम कैसे दर्ज करें, यह `dinah guide on-behalf` बताता है।

contents.header.collection.context: The sentence above the tree `dinah list` prints when the reference names a whole collection rather than one entity. help.flags.context: The heading above the flags that belong to the invocation rather than to one command.

help.group.serve.context: A heading of the help block, grouping the commands beneath it.

help.group.work.context: A heading of the help block, grouping the commands beneath it.

help.guide.context: The closing line of a command's help page, pointing at the guide that explains that command's argument language. {topic} is the guide's topic name, which is machine vocabulary and is never translated.

help.reading.context: The line below the help block's footer, pointing a reader at the guides the binary carries and at the quick start. The URL names a location rather than reading as prose, and it stays as it is in every language.

help.reference-kinds.context: One argument's meaning followed by the kinds of thing its reference may name. {summary} is the argument's own sentence. {kinds} holds the labels reference.kind.workbench, reference.kind.workstream, reference.kind.column, reference.kind.card, reference.kind.below-card and reference.kind.collection, joined by a semicolon and a space, and those labels are translated prose rather than machine vocabulary, so unlike {kind} in the unknown-field refusals a word of this sentence may agree with what is substituted here. No label may itself contain a semicolon followed by a space, because the guard over this clause splits the list on that pair.

help.refusals.text: क्या गलत हो सकता है, उसी क्रम में जिसमें हर जाँच होती है:
help.refusals.context: The heading above a command's ordered precondition list in its own help.

help.tagline.context: The first line of the help block, the tool's one-sentence description.

help.vocabulary.context: One argument's meaning followed by the closed set of values it accepts. {summary} is the argument's own sentence and {values} is the members separated by commas. The members are machine vocabulary and are never translated.

init.actor.recorded.text: Dinah ने आपको {path} में actor {actor} के रूप में दर्ज किया, और अब आप जो भी करेंगे, Dinah उस पर यही नाम दर्ज करेगी। इसे बदलने के लिए `dinah config set actor <name>` चलाएँ, या हटाने के लिए `dinah config set actor` चलाएँ।
init.actor.recorded.context: Printed after init records the actor in the person's own configuration. Dinah records it only when no flag, variable or setting already named an actor. {actor} is the name recorded and {path} is the file it was written to. The word Dinah names the product and stays in Latin script; do not respell it. The command text is typed literally and stays as it is.

init.actor.unrecorded.text: Dinah ने वर्कबेंच बना दिया, लेकिन {path} में आपको actor के रूप में दर्ज नहीं कर सकी ({reason})। आप कौन हैं यह बताने के लिए `dinah config set actor <name>` चलाएँ।
init.actor.unrecorded.context: Printed after init creates the workbench and then fails to write the person's own configuration. The workbench exists, so this is a report rather than a refusal and carries no refusal name. {path} is the file Dinah tried to write and {reason} is the cause, which arrives in English from the operating system. The word Dinah names the product and stays in Latin script; do not respell it. The command text is typed literally and stays as it is.

instructions.global.context: The label above the user-global instruction layer.

instructions.loop.context: The line served with the instructions where the card's column declares a loop_limit. {count} is how often this card has already left that column backwards, {limit} is what the column declares, and {column} names the column.

listing-comments.empty.context: Printed when dinah list <card>/comments is asked about a card that carries no comments. No table follows, and the call succeeds: a card with nothing to say is an answer rather than a mistake.

listing-comments.header.context: The sentence above the table dinah list <card>/comments prints, naming the collection the reader asked about. {count} is how many comments the card carries.

listing-items.empty.context: Printed when dinah list <card>/checklist is asked about a card that carries no checklist items. No table follows, and the call succeeds: a card with nothing on its checklist is an answer rather than a mistake.

log.attachment-renamed.context: The detail of a recorded attachment_renamed, carrying the old filename as {from} and the new filename as {to}.

log.item-filed.standing.context: The detail of an item_filed line a column's standing declaration wrote: the declaring column and the entry key. {column} is the title the event captured at write time, falling back to the stored identifier on a line that captured none, and {key} is the entry's key, which is machine vocabulary and is never translated. A hand filing's line carries no standing key and draws no detail.

log.manual-correction.text: {from} से {to}, हाथ से किए गए संपादन से दर्ज
log.manual-correction.context: The detail of a witnessed correction, carrying the column the journal believed and the column the anchor records. It reads differently from a move because nobody chose this transition; the tool found it.

log.moved.context: The detail of a recorded move, carrying the titles as they stood at the time.

log.override.context: The mark on a move admitted under an operator's override.

log.reject.context: The mark on a move whose destination is the departure column's own reject_to target.

log.renumbered.context: The detail of a recorded renumbered, carrying the number the card arrived holding as {from} and the number the repair gave it as {to}.

log.tier-overridden.context: The detail of a tier_overridden line: the column the override concerns, and the requirement on either side of the write. {column} is the title the event captured at write time, falling back to the stored identifier on a line that captured none. {from} is the previous requirement, or log.tier-overridden.no-requirement where the card asked for nothing. log.tier-overridden.reason is appended after this one only when the event carries a reason, which an ordinary `set <ref> tier <value> --at <column>` write does not.

log.tier-overridden.no-requirement.context: Spliced in as {from} on a tier_overridden line whose own from is empty, meaning the card asked for nothing at this column before the write.

log.tier-overridden.reason.context: Appended to log.tier-overridden's detail when the event carries a reason, which today only a raise writes. It is a parenthesis around the prose and nothing else, which is why every catalog answers it the same way.

lsp.completion.card.detail.context: The detail line beside one card candidate in a completion list. {column} is the title of the column the card stands in and {state} is its condition.

lsp.completion.column.detail.context: The detail line beside one column candidate in a completion list. {slug} is the column's own handle and {position} is its one-based place in the flow.

lsp.completion.workstream.detail.context: The detail line beside one workstream candidate in a completion list. {slug} is the workstream's own handle.

lsp.hover.workbench.context: The last line of every hover the language server answers, so a reader with two repositories open knows which workbench answered. {workbench} is the workbench's title.

lsp.label.attachment.context: The inline annotation and hover line for an attachment reference. {filename} is the payload's original name.

lsp.label.card.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a card reference with no holder. {title} is the card's title and {column} is the title of the column it stands in.

lsp.label.card.held.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a card somebody is holding. {holder} is the owner name recorded on the claim.

lsp.label.column.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a column that holds a card neither on the way in nor on the way out. {title} is the column's title.

lsp.label.column.holds-both.text: {title}, दोनों दिशाओं में कार्ड रोकता है
lsp.label.column.holds-both.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a column that holds a card on the way in and on the way out.

lsp.label.column.holds-in.text: {title}, प्रवेश करती कार्ड को रोकता है
lsp.label.column.holds-in.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a column that holds a card on the way in while an item naming it is unresolved.

lsp.label.column.holds-out.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a column that holds a card on the way out while an item naming it is unresolved.

lsp.label.item.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a checklist item naming no owner. {kind} and {state} are canonical tokens spliced untranslated, such as open_question and pending.

lsp.label.item.owned.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a checklist item that names an owner. {kind} and {state} are canonical tokens spliced untranslated; {owner} is the owner name.

lsp.label.unresolved.text: इस वर्कबेंच पर कुछ भी नामित नहीं करता
lsp.label.unresolved.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a value at a declared front-matter reference position that resolves to no entity. It is a report of what the value names and not a diagnostic.

lsp.label.workstream.context: The inline annotation and hover line for a workstream reference. {title} is the workstream's title.

lsp.log.no-refresh-support.text: इस संपादक ने इनले-संकेत ताज़ा करने का समर्थन घोषित नहीं किया, इसलिए इनलाइन चिह्न तब तक नहीं बदलेगा जब तक उसका दस्तावेज़ संपादित या दोबारा खोला न जाए
lsp.log.no-refresh-support.context: The line the language server writes to the editor's log once at startup when the client declared no inlay-hint refresh support. It tells a reader why a label may go stale, rather than leaving them to conclude the annotation lies.

lsp.log.slow-walk.entered.text: वर्कबेंच का चक्कर {duration} लगा, जबकि पोल अंतराल {interval} है, इसलिए ताज़ा होने की देरी अब अंतराल के बजाय चक्कर से तय होती है
lsp.log.slow-walk.entered.context: The warning the language server writes to the editor's log on entering the state where a change walk outruns the poll interval. {duration} is the measured walk and {interval} is the interval it outran. It is sent once on the edge and never once per tick.

lsp.log.slow-walk.left.text: वर्कबेंच का चक्कर {duration} लगा, जबकि पोल अंतराल {interval} है, इसलिए ताज़ा होने की देरी फिर अंतराल पर आ गई है
lsp.log.slow-walk.left.context: The warning the language server writes to the editor's log on leaving the state where a change walk outruns the poll interval. {duration} is the walk that left the state and {interval} is the interval the loop is again sleeping.

lsp.log.workbench.text: {root} पर मौजूद वर्कबेंच परोसी जा रही है
lsp.log.workbench.context: The line the language server writes to the editor's log once at startup, naming which workbench answered. {root} is that workbench's directory.

lsp.no-workbench.text: Dinah को यहाँ कोई वर्कबेंच नहीं मिली, इसलिए अभी कुछ भी चिह्नित नहीं है
lsp.no-workbench.context: The one message the language server shows a reader when no workbench resolved at startup. The server keeps serving and retries on every poll, so this says what is missing rather than reporting a failure.

mcp.no-default.context: The one line dinah mcp writes to stderr when startup discovery resolved a workbench the root does not contain or the ancestor walk found none, and a later call has to be told no default will answer.

mcp.reach.text: आप {root} के नीचे की किसी भी वर्कबेंच तक पहुँच सकते हैं; यह सर्वर तयशुदा रूप से {title} परोस रहा है। workbenches उपकरण रूट के नीचे की वर्कबेंच सूचीबद्ध करता है, और किसी भी दूसरे उपकरण की workbench property किसी एक को नामती है।
mcp.reach.context: The third paragraph of the working agreement when the server has a default workbench. {root} is the directory --root or DINAH_MCP_ROOT named, and {title} is the default workbench's own title.

mcp.reach.nodefault.text: आप {root} के नीचे की किसी भी वर्कबेंच तक पहुँच सकते हैं; यह सर्वर कोई तयशुदा वर्कबेंच नहीं परोस रहा। workbenches उपकरण रूट के नीचे की वर्कबेंच सूचीबद्ध करता है, और किसी भी दूसरे उपकरण की workbench property किसी एक को नामती है।
mcp.reach.nodefault.context: The third paragraph of the working agreement when the server has no default workbench. {root} is the directory --root or DINAH_MCP_ROOT named.

mcp.reach.nodefault.unbounded.text: आप किसी भी ऐसी वर्कबेंच तक पहुँच सकते हैं जिसे आप नाम दे सकें; इस सर्वर को कोई रूट नहीं दिया गया है और यह तयशुदा रूप से कुछ भी नहीं परोस रहा है। workbenches उपकरण को खोजने के लिए रूट चाहिए और यहाँ dinah.no-workbench-found के साथ मना करता है, इसलिए जो वर्कबेंच चाहिए उसे किसी भी दूसरे उपकरण की workbench property में सीधे नामें।
mcp.reach.nodefault.unbounded.context: The third paragraph of the working agreement when the server has no default workbench and no root: --root and DINAH_MCP_ROOT were both empty and discovery found nothing, so PathUnderRoot admits every candidate and only the checks made when the workbench is opened can refuse one.

mcp.reach.unbounded.text: आप किसी भी ऐसी वर्कबेंच तक पहुँच सकते हैं जिसे आप नाम दे सकें; इस सर्वर को कोई रूट नहीं दिया गया है और यह तयशुदा रूप से {title} परोस रहा है। workbenches उपकरण को खोजने के लिए रूट चाहिए, इसलिए बिना पथ के किए गए कॉल का उत्तर यहाँ केवल उसी तयशुदा वर्कबेंच से मिलता है जिसे यह पहले से जानता है, प्रतिक्रिया पर unbounded सेट करते हुए, न कि किसी खोज के परिणाम के रूप में; चाहें तो वर्कबेंच को किसी भी दूसरे उपकरण की workbench property में सीधे नामें, या तयशुदा वर्कबेंच के उपयोग के लिए इसे बिना नाम के छोड़ दें।
mcp.reach.unbounded.context: The third paragraph of the working agreement when the server has a default workbench but no root: --root and DINAH_MCP_ROOT were both empty, discovery found a workbench to serve as default, and the auto-narrowing that used to bind root to that workbench's own directory (dinah-307) no longer runs, so PathUnderRoot admits every other candidate too. {title} is the default workbench's own title. The workbenches tool still cannot search an empty root, so a call naming no path answers the one candidate it already knows, the default, marked unbounded rather than presented as a completed search (dinah-301); it no longer refuses dinah.no-workbench-found in this one combination, though it still does when there is no default to fall back on.

next.above-tier.text: तैयार, आपके घोषित स्तर से ऊपर
next.above-tier.context: Printed beside a column that offers no card because the tier the caller declared is admitted for none of the work standing there, in place of next.none, which says only that nothing is ready.

next.awaiting-outside.text: बाहर के किसी व्यक्ति की प्रतीक्षा में
next.awaiting-outside.context: Printed beside a column that offers no card because it waits on somebody outside the workbench, in place of next.none, which says only that nothing is ready.

next.no-taker.text: यहाँ से कुछ नहीं लिया जाता
next.no-taker.context: Printed beside a column that offers no card because no act could take one up from there, in place of next.none, which says only that nothing is ready. A done column holding four ready cards prints this one.

next.none.context: Printed beside a column offering no card.

next.take.claim.context: The value under the offers listing's Take column on a card an owner takes up where it stands. It names the command a reader types, so it reads as the act rather than as a sentence about it.

next.take.pull.context: The value under the offers listing's Take column on a card that leaves by a pull into the column beyond, because nobody takes work up where it stands. It names the command a reader types.

outcome.stale.text: आपके पढ़ने के बाद कार्ड बदल गया; अब उसका संस्करण {revision} है
outcome.stale.context: The sentence after the stale outcome name. {revision} is the card's current revision.

outcome.unreachable.context: The sentence after the unreachable outcome name.

page.act.back.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A move choice that goes back along the flow. {column} is the column's title.

page.act.block.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button of a card's block form.

page.act.claim.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button of a card's claim form.

page.act.comment.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button of a card's comment form.

page.act.comment-text.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of the comment form's text box.

page.act.kind.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of a block form's kind box.

page.act.list.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A link on a card's sheet or a generic page to the list read.

page.act.move.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button of a card's move form.

page.act.move-to.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of a card's move choice.

page.act.next_card.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A link on a generic page to the next read.

page.act.pull.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button of a card's pull form. {column} is the destination column's title.

page.act.pull-note.text: खींचना कतार के सबसे आगे वाले कार्ड को {column} में ले जाता है, और अगर वह कोई दूसरा कार्ड हो तो पुराना बताता है।
page.act.pull-note.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. Written under the pull button. {column} is the destination column's title.

page.act.reason.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of a block or unblock form's reason box.

page.act.release.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button of a card's release form.

page.act.show.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A link on a card's sheet to the show read of the card.

page.act.status.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A link on a generic page to the status read, which is the board.

page.act.unblock.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button of a card's unblock form.

page.acting-as.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. Written before the actor every click acts as, in the topbar.

page.acts.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of the section holding a card's forms.

page.add.column.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of the add form's column choice.

page.add.first-column.text: पहला कॉलम जो कार्ड स्वीकार करता है
page.add.first-column.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The add form's default column choice, which leaves the column to the workbench.

page.add.more.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The summary of the add form's optional fields.

page.add.priority.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of the add form's priority box.

page.add.route.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of the add form's route box.

page.add.severity.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of the add form's severity box.

page.add.submit.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The add form's button.

page.add.title.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of the add form's title box.

page.back.columns.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The text of the back link a detail page begins with on a narrow screen, which returns to the columns.

page.board.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The board page's title and the topbar link to it.

page.cards.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The card list page's title and the topbar link to it.

page.cards.query.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of the query box above the card list.

page.cards.run-query.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button that runs the card list's query.

page.column.capacity.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A badge on a column's page naming its capacity. {capacity} is a number.

page.column.operator-owned.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A badge on a column's page for a column only the operator works.

page.column.takes-work-up.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A badge on a column's page for a column whose owners claim work.

page.columns.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The sidebar's heading and accessible name.

page.defect.text: यह पेज नहीं बन सका, और यह Dinah की गड़बड़ी है, आपके किए किसी काम की नहीं।
page.defect.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The sentence of the page answered with status 500.

page.defect.title.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The title of the page answered with status 500.

page.dinah.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The brand text in the topbar when no workbench opened. It is the product's name.

page.filter.text: बोर्ड को एक क्वेरी से छानें
page.filter.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of the toolbar's query box.

page.filter.clear.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of the link that removes the query filter chip.

page.lane.of-capacity.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A lane's card count against its column's capacity. {count} and {capacity} are numbers.

page.layer.column.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The heading of a column's own instruction layer.

page.layer.global.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The heading of the user-global instruction layer on a card's sheet.

page.layer.standing.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The heading of the workbench's standing instruction layer on a card's sheet.

page.log.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The command log's title, the topbar link to its page, and the accessible name of the log panel.

page.log.again.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button that runs a logged command again, on an entry made from a card's form, which answers stale once the card has changed.

page.log.again-unguarded.text: कार्ड की अभी की स्थिति पर फिर से चलाएँ
page.log.again-unguarded.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button that runs a logged command again on an entry that carries no revision, so it acts on the card as it now stands however it has changed.

page.log.copy.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button the pages' script puts beside a logged command line to copy it.

page.log.run.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The button that runs the command line typed into the log.

page.log.stale.text: यह पेज बनने के बाद {card} बदल गया; अब वह {column} में है, {state}।
page.log.stale.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. Written under a stale entry of the command log. {card} is the card's reference, {column} its column and {state} its state.

page.nav.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of the topbar's navigation.

page.new-card.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The toolbar link to the form that adds a card.

page.next.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The toolbar link to the next work on offer.

page.no-actor.text: कोई कर्ता नहीं, इसलिए हर कार्य अस्वीकार होता है; dinah ui को --actor के साथ शुरू करें
page.no-actor.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. Written in the topbar when the process resolved no actor. --actor and dinah ui stay as they are.

page.open-as-window.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The link on a card's page that opens the card as a window over the board.

page.search.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The search page's title.

page.search.phrase.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of the search page's phrase box.

page.search.query.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The label of the search page's query box.

page.search.run.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The search page's button.

page.sheet.block-kind.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card sheet row giving the block's kind.

page.sheet.block-reason.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card sheet row giving the block's reason.

page.sheet.checklist.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The summary of a card sheet's checklist.

page.sheet.column.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card sheet row naming the column.

page.sheet.comments.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The summary of a card sheet's comments.

page.sheet.held-since.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The holder row's value with the claim's start. {since} is a time stamp.

page.sheet.held-until.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The holder row's value with the claim's expiry. {expires} is a time stamp.

page.sheet.holder.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card sheet row naming the holder.

page.sheet.instructions.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The summary of a card sheet's instructions. {column} is the column's title.

page.sheet.links.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The summary of a card sheet's links and attachments.

page.sheet.pull-destination.text: खींचने पर यह यहाँ जाता है
page.sheet.pull-destination.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card sheet row naming where a pull takes the card.

page.sheet.workstreams.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card sheet row naming the card's workstreams.

page.state.active.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The reader's word for a card somebody holds.

page.state.blocked.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The reader's word for a blocked card.

page.state.held.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The badge of a held card on its sheet. {state} is the state word and {holder} the actor holding it.

page.state.ready.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The reader's word for a card that is ready.

page.table.column.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card table's column heading for the column.

page.table.holder.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card table's column heading for the holder.

page.table.ref.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card table's column heading for the reference.

page.table.state.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card table's column heading for the state.

page.table.title.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. A card table's column heading for the title.

page.theme.text: हल्के और गहरे के बीच बदलें
page.theme.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of the theme toggle the pages' script inserts.

page.title.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The document title: {page} is the page's own title and {workbench} the workbench's title, separated by a middle dot.

page.tree.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The tree page's title.

page.tree.group.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The heading of one group of the tree page. {axis} is the field grouped on and {value} the value the group holds.

page.tree.hidden.text: यहाँ नहीं दिखाया गया: {subjects} कार्ड वाले {children} समूह, और {filtered} कार्ड जिन्हें फ़िल्टर ने छोड़ दिया।
page.tree.hidden.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. Written under a tree group that hides part of what it holds. The three slots are numbers.

page.views.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The views page's title and the topbar link to it.

page.window.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of a window's buttons.

page.window.close.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of a window's close button.

page.window.maximize.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of a window's maximize button.

page.window.minimize.context: A string the pages of dinah ui and dinah serve draw in a browser. The accessible name of a window's minimize button.

param.add.priority.summary.context: The meaning of the priority argument of `dinah add`, printed in that command's arguments table.

param.add.severity.summary.text: कार्ड किस गंभीरता स्तर के साथ दर्ज करना है, उन स्तरों में से जो यह वर्कबेंच घोषित करती है
param.add.severity.summary.context: The meaning of the severity argument of `dinah add`, printed in that command's arguments table.

param.add.title.summary.text: कार्ड का शीर्षक, एक ही शब्द में या उद्धरण चिह्नों के भीतर

param.archived.summary.context: The meaning of the --archived flag, shared by restore, show, path and contents, printed in each command's arguments table. The same flag on `dinah search` widens the scan instead and carries its own sentence under param.search.archived.summary.

param.attach.description.summary.text: संलग्नक का वर्णन करने वाली एक पंक्ति, उसी के साथ रखी जाती है

param.attach.file.summary.context: The meaning of the file argument of `dinah attach`, printed in that command's arguments table.

param.attach.ref.summary.text: फ़ाइल किससे जुड़ेगी; कार्ड के नीचे वह एक टिप्पणी है, या, --replace के साथ, वह संलग्नक जिसके बाइट आप बदल रहे हैं
