refusal.layer-collision.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name layer-collision. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.layer-collision.next.text: ; परत का नाम बदलें, फिर पुष्टि के लिए `dinah check` चलाएँ
refusal.layer-collision.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.layer-collision as the next step. Written for a refusal nothing raises today.

refusal.malformed.text: {detail} अनुपस्थित है, खाली है, या पार्स नहीं हो सकता
refusal.malformed.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name malformed. {detail} names the field or argument that failed.

refusal.malformed.at.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed when the refusal carries a path: the file the missing or broken field belongs to.

refusal.malformed.claimed-twice.text: , और {claimants} दोनों इसे {retired} के लिए घोषित करते हैं
refusal.malformed.claimed-twice.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed when a reshape's new definition has two columns claiming one retirement through replaces. {claimants} names both declaring columns and {retired} is the identifier they both claim.

refusal.malformed.fix.text: ; फ़ाइल को स्वयं संपादित करके जोड़ें, फिर पुष्टि के लिए `dinah check` चलाएँ
refusal.malformed.fix.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed after refusal.malformed.at, naming the repair.

refusal.malformed.fix-named.text: ; फ़ाइल को स्वयं संपादित करके जोड़ें, फिर पुष्टि के लिए `dinah check --workbench {workbench}` चलाएँ
refusal.malformed.fix-named.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed as the next step wherever a workbench was resolved for this invocation, which covers every reader standing in one and every reader who named one with --workbench from somewhere else. {workbench} is the workbench directory, and naming it is what lets the reader confirm the hand edit on the workbench whose file would not read. The workbench is attached by the raise site rather than by the head, so this repair renders exactly where the file path does and nowhere else. The sibling entry without the flag is the alternation's unconditional last member. The command spelling is machine vocabulary and is not translated.

refusal.malformed.in-file.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed when the refusal carries a file: the definition file the reader named, whose contents will not parse.

refusal.malformed.legal-values.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed when a declared field's `values` list refuses the value written. {legalValues} is the comma-joined list of the field's legal values in declaration order, which is machine vocabulary and is never translated.

refusal.malformed.next.text: ; कमांड को `dinah {usage}` की तरह लिखकर दोबारा आज़माएँ
refusal.malformed.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed as the next step when the refusal names no file. {usage} is the syntax line of the command the reader typed.

refusal.malformed.next-file.text: ; {file} को स्वयं संपादित करके ठीक करें, फिर कमांड दोबारा चलाएँ
refusal.malformed.next-file.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed as the next step when the refusal carries a file. It names no dinah check, because the command that read the file created no workbench to check.

refusal.malformed.one-line.text: ; {detail} का मान एक ही पंक्ति में रखा जाता है, और आपने जो मान दिया वह पंक्ति-विराम रखता है
refusal.malformed.one-line.context: Spliced onto refusal.malformed when the refusal carries the one-line marker: the field is stored as a frontmatter key rather than as the anchor's prose, so its value holds one line. {detail} is the field name, which is machine vocabulary and is never translated.

refusal.malformed.reads-as-a-card-refere.text: ; Dinah {cardRef} को कार्ड संदर्भ के रूप में पढ़ता है, इसलिए वर्कबेंच उपनाम डैश और संख्या पर समाप्त नहीं हो सकता
refusal.malformed.reads-as-a-card-refere.context: Spliced onto the malformed sentence when `dinah init --slug` is handed a slug the reference grammar would read as a card. {cardRef} carries that slug. It opens with a semicolon, the way refusal.malformed.at and refusal.malformed.fix do.

refusal.missing-field.text: कॉलम {column} को {detail} चाहिए, और यह कार्ड उसके लिए कोई मान नहीं रखता
refusal.missing-field.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name missing-field, which a move or a pull into a column that requires a field the card holds no value for meets. {detail} is the first such key in the column's own declaration order, and {column} names the column that asked.

refusal.missing-field.next.text: ; `dinah set` से उसके लिए एक मान लिखें, फिर यह कॉलम कार्ड को ले लेगा
refusal.missing-field.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.missing-field as the next step. It names the command that writes the value and says what the write buys, and it names neither of the two acts the row refuses, because the row fires on a move and on a pull alike and a reader refused at a pull never moved. The command name is syntax and stays as it is.

refusal.missing-field.next-operator.text: ; `dinah set` से उसके लिए एक मान लिखें, फिर यह कॉलम कार्ड को ले लेगा, या इस एक चाल को स्वयं --override से आगे बढ़ाएँ
refusal.missing-field.next-operator.context: Spliced onto refusal.missing-field as the next step where the caller who was refused is the operator.

refusal.no-operator.text: यह वर्कबेंच कोई संचालक नियत नहीं करती, इसलिए उसकी आरक्षित क्रियाएँ मृत हैं
refusal.no-operator.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name no-operator. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.no-operator.next.text: ; वर्कबेंच की workbench.md में operator पंक्ति जोड़ें, फिर पुष्टि के लिए `dinah check` चलाएँ
refusal.no-operator.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.no-operator as the next step. operator is a key name and stays in Latin script.

refusal.no-operator.next-named.text: ; वर्कबेंच की workbench.md में operator पंक्ति जोड़ें, फिर पुष्टि के लिए `dinah check --workbench {workbench}` चलाएँ
refusal.no-operator.next-named.context: Spliced onto refusal.no-operator as the next step wherever a workbench was resolved for this invocation, which covers every reader standing in one and every reader who named one with --workbench from somewhere else. {workbench} is the workbench directory, and naming it is what lets the reader confirm the operator line on the workbench he named. The sibling entry without the flag is the alternation's unconditional last member. The command spelling is machine vocabulary and is not translated.

refusal.no-owner.text: Dinah नहीं जानती कि आप कौन हैं
refusal.no-owner.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name no-owner. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.no-owner.next.text: ; यह बताने के लिए `dinah config set actor <name>` चलाएँ
refusal.no-owner.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.no-owner as the next step, carrying the clause that base entry used to end with.

refusal.no-reason.text: बाधा के साथ कारण आता है, ऐसा लिखा कि संचालक उसका उत्तर दे सके
refusal.no-reason.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name no-reason. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.no-reason.next.text: ; `dinah block {card} "वह प्रश्न जिसका उत्तर संचालक को देना है"` चलाएँ
refusal.no-reason.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.no-reason as the next step. {card} is the card reference the reader named. Written for block; raise raises this refusal too and renders refusal.no-reason.raise.next in place of this entry.

refusal.no-reason.raise.text: स्तर बढ़ाने के साथ कारण आता है, जो बताता है कि आपने ऐसा क्या पाया जो काम को इस पड़ाव के माँगे गए स्तर से ऊपर ले जाता है
refusal.no-reason.raise.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name no-reason when the raise command raised it. A command adding no key of its own renders refusal.no-reason instead.

refusal.no-reason.raise.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.no-reason.raise as its next step. {card} is the card reference the reader named. The raise command renders it; every other command renders refusal.no-reason.next.

refusal.not-blocked.text: यह कार्ड बाधित नहीं है, इसलिए हटाने को कुछ नहीं है
refusal.not-blocked.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name not-blocked. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.not-blocked.next.text: ; यह कहाँ खड़ा है यह देखने के लिए `dinah show {card}` चलाएँ
refusal.not-blocked.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.not-blocked as the next step. {card} is the card reference the reader named.

refusal.not-holder.text: यह कार्ड आपने नहीं लिया है; {detail} ने लिया है
refusal.not-holder.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name not-holder. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.not-holder.next.text: ; Dinah आपको कौन मानता है यह देखने के लिए `dinah whoami` चलाएँ, या {detail} से इसे छोड़ने को कहें
refusal.not-holder.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.not-holder as the next step when somebody else holds the card. {detail} is that owner.

refusal.not-holder.next-unheld.context: Spliced onto refusal.not-holder.unnamed as the next step when nobody holds the card. {card} is the card reference the reader named.

refusal.not-holder.unnamed.text: यह कार्ड किसी ने नहीं लिया है, इसलिए छोड़ने को कुछ नहीं है
refusal.not-holder.unnamed.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name not-holder when nobody holds the card, in place of refusal.not-holder. Release and raise both raise this refusal, and the sentence is written for release because releasing is still how the card is freed for somebody else to claim and then raise.

refusal.not-operator.text: यह क्रिया संचालक की है, और आप {detail} हैं
refusal.not-operator.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name not-operator. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.not-operator.next.text: ; संचालक से इसे चलाने को कहें, या Dinah आपको कौन मानता है यह देखने के लिए `dinah whoami` चलाएँ
refusal.not-operator.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.not-operator as the next step.

refusal.not-operator.next-harness.text: ; आपने {harness} हार्नेस घोषित किया है, और यह क्रिया संचालक की है; यदि संचालक ने इस पर अपना निर्णय कहा है, तो उसे दर्ज करने से पहले `dinah guide on-behalf` पढ़ें
refusal.not-operator.next-harness.context: Spliced onto refusal.not-operator as the next step, in place of refusal.not-operator.next, when the request that raised the refusal declared a harness. {harness} is that harness's name. The guide name on-behalf and the command are not translated.

refusal.not-requester.text: दावा अपने माँगने वाले को ही धारक बताता है, यह {detail} को बताता है
refusal.not-requester.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name not-requester. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.not-requester.next.text: ; स्वयं को धारक बताएँ, या {detail} के रूप में इसे लें
refusal.not-requester.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.not-requester as the next step. {detail} is the holder the claim named. Written for claim, the one verb that raises this refusal.

refusal.terminal.text: कॉलम {detail} एक done कॉलम है, और उससे आगे कुछ नहीं जाता
refusal.terminal.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name terminal. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.terminal.next.text: ; इसके बजाय कोई पहले का कॉलम बताएँ
refusal.terminal.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.terminal as the next step.

refusal.undeclared-field.text: यह वर्कबेंच {kind} पर {detail} नाम का कोई फ़ील्ड घोषित नहीं करती
refusal.undeclared-field.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name undeclared-field, which is what a write naming a key this workbench does not declare on the resolved kind meets. {detail} is the key the reader typed. {kind} is the kind the reference resolved to, read off the tool rather than written here, so it is machine vocabulary and is never translated. No word of the sentence may agree with {kind}, because the token substituted there is untranslated English and no language can predict its gender, its number or the sound it starts with. The keys this workbench does declare on that kind print beneath as rows, one to a row.

refusal.undeclared-field.elsewhere.context: Spliced onto refusal.undeclared-field where this workbench declares the key on some other kind, which tells a reader the key exists somewhere rather than nowhere. {kinds} carries the kinds the declaration does name, read off the declaration, so it is machine vocabulary and is never translated.

refusal.undeclared-field.next.text: इसे `workbench.md` के `fields` ब्लॉक में घोषित करें, या ऊपर सूचीबद्ध कोई कुंजी नाम दें।
refusal.undeclared-field.next.context: The next step of refusal.undeclared-field. It names the block a reader edits to declare the key, and the rows above it are the keys already declared. The file name and the block name are syntax and stay as they are.

refusal.unknown.text: {name} दर्ज हुआ, और Dinah के पास उसका संदेश नहीं है: {detail}
refusal.unknown.context: The fallback sentence for a refusal name no catalog entry covers.

refusal.unknown-card.text: इस वर्कबेंच पर कोई कार्ड {detail} नहीं है
refusal.unknown-card.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name unknown-card. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.unknown-card.next.text: ; इस वर्कबेंच के कार्ड देखने के लिए `dinah list cards` चलाएँ
refusal.unknown-card.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.unknown-card as the next step.

refusal.unknown-card.workstream.next.text: ; {workstream} एक वर्कस्ट्रीम का नाम है, इसलिए संदर्भ इसी तरह लिखें, या यह देखने के लिए कि संदर्भ कैसे लिखा जाता है `dinah guide references` चलाएँ
refusal.unknown-card.workstream.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.unknown-card in place of its usual next step, when the reference names no card and does name a workstream. It is what a reader meets who typed a bare workstream slug, which the retired kind-prefixed commands accepted and the generic get and set do not. {workstream} is that workstream's reference in the grammar's own spelling, which is machine vocabulary and is never translated. The command line inside it is syntax and stays as it is.

refusal.unknown-column.text: यह वर्कबेंच कोई कॉलम {detail} घोषित नहीं करती; यह ये घोषित करती है
refusal.unknown-column.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name unknown-column. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.unknown-column.next.text: इनमें से किसी एक के साथ `dinah {command}` चलाएँ
refusal.unknown-column.next.context: Printed under the columns refusal.unknown-column lists, on its own line and with no leading punctuation. {command} is the command the reader typed, because this refusal answers ls, move, add and next.

refusal.unresolved-item.text: इस कार्ड पर मद {detail} है, जो अनसुलझी है
refusal.unresolved-item.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name unresolved-item. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.unresolved-item.next.text: ; इसका उत्तर दें, फिर उस मद को सुलझाएँ, सत्यापित करें या विफल करें
refusal.unresolved-item.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.unresolved-item as the next step. It names the three verbs that settle an item, because each of them is a command.

refusal.unresolved-item.next-operator.text: ; इसका उत्तर दें, फिर उस मद को सुलझाएँ, सत्यापित करें या विफल करें, या इस एक चाल को स्वयं --override के साथ पूरा करें
refusal.unresolved-item.next-operator.context: Spliced onto refusal.unresolved-item as the next step where the caller who was refused is the operator.

refusal.unsupported-version.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name unsupported-version. {detail} carries the identifier, owner or column the refusal is about.

refusal.unsupported-version.next.text: ; नया Dinah स्थापित करें, या इस वर्कबेंच को उसे पढ़ने वाली बिल्ड से खोलें
refusal.unsupported-version.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.unsupported-version as the next step, after the window clause.

refusal.unsupported-version.window.text: ; यह बिल्ड {floor} से {ceiling} तक पढ़ती है
refusal.unsupported-version.window.context: Spliced onto refusal.unsupported-version when the refusal names the window this build opens. {floor} and {ceiling} are profile revision identities such as `dinah-core 0.1`, and a translator moves them within the sentence without respelling them.

reshape.applied.text: यह वर्कबेंच अब नया आकार रखता है।
reshape.applied.context: The first line of a reshape that applied, printed where a preview prints the line saying nothing was written.

reshape.blocked.text: अवरुद्ध रहते हुए ले जाए गए: {cards}।
reshape.blocked.context: One row of a reshape report, naming the carried cards that arrived still blocked, since a reshape carries a block through untouched.

reshape.carry.text: {id} अपने कार्ड {destination} को भेजता है। कार्ड: {count}।
reshape.carry.context: One row of a reshape report: where a retiring column's cards go and how many there are. A preview reads it as what would be carried and an applied run as what was.

reshape.column.added.context: One row of a reshape report: a column the new definition adds.

reshape.column.adopted.text: हटाया गया {id}, एक पहचानकर्ता जिसे यह वर्कबेंच अब नहीं बताता
reshape.column.adopted.context: One row of a reshape report: an identifier a --map entry adopted, which names no live column and so carries no title.

reshape.column.kept.context: One row of a reshape report: a column the new definition keeps.

reshape.column.retired.context: One row of a reshape report: a live column the new definition drops.

reshape.confirm.text: इसे लागू करने के लिए वही आदेश --yes के साथ फिर चलाएँ।
reshape.confirm.context: The closing line of a reshape preview, naming the flag that carries the run out.

reshape.empty.text: {id} हटाया जाता है, उसमें कोई कार्ड खड़ा नहीं है।
reshape.empty.context: One row of a reshape report: a retiring column nothing had to be carried out of.

reshape.partial.text: यह चाल रुकने से पहले लिखना शुरू कर चुकी थी, इसलिए यह वर्कबेंच अपने पुराने और नए आकार के बीच खड़ा है। आगे वही है जो उसने लिखा।
reshape.partial.context: The first line of a reshape that refused after its write phase had begun, printed where a preview prints the line saying nothing was written and an applied run prints the line saying the shape is on disk. The three openings are different because the three states are, and an operator who is told only which refusal stopped the run cannot tell a half-applied workbench from an untouched one.

reshape.preview.text: कुछ नहीं लिखा गया। --yes के साथ चलने पर यह होता।
reshape.preview.context: The first line of a reshape preview, which says at the top that none of the page below has happened.

reshape.retry.text: अस्वीकृति जो बताती है उसे ठीक करें और वही आदेश उसी स्रोत के साथ फिर चलाएँ। ऊपर के चरण दूसरे चलने पर छोड़ दिए जाते हैं और शेष आकार लिख दिया जाता है।
reshape.retry.context: The closing line of the report for a reshape that stopped part way through, which is what tells the operator the state is finishable and how. Every write-phase step is idempotent, so the second run does what the first did not.

reshape.standing-withdrawn.text: पुनर्रचना द्वारा वापस लिया गया: कॉलम {column}, जिसकी घोषणा ने यह मद दर्ज की थी, हटा दिया गया, और हटाया गया कॉलम कुछ नहीं माँगता।
reshape.standing-withdrawn.context: The comment a reshape writes on each pending standing item of a column it retires, designated as the item's resolution. {column} is the retired column's title, or its identifier for an adopted retirement entry, which carries no title. It is stored on the item rather than printed, so every catalog answers it in the base language.

reshape.stranded.text: ऐसे कॉलम में खड़े कार्ड जिसे यह चाल नहीं जानती: {count}। उनके पहचानकर्ता खोजने के लिए `dinah check` चलाएँ।
reshape.stranded.context: The reshape report's line for cards standing in a column that is in neither the workbench's own sequence nor the new definition. The count is reported rather than the identifiers, because reshape diffs two column lists and `dinah check` is the command that walks every card.

reshape.updated.text: नई परिभाषा ने कॉलम {id} को बदला।
reshape.updated.context: One row of a reshape report: a kept column whose anchor the rewrite actually changed, which is what the run recorded a column_updated event for.

reshape.withdrawn.context: One row of a reshape report under a retirement, counting the pending standing items naming the retiring column on live cards anywhere. A preview reads it as what would be withdrawn and an applied run as what was.

reshape.wrote.added.text: नई परिभाषा द्वारा जोड़े गए कॉलम, अब लिखे गए और प्रवाह में: {count}।
reshape.wrote.added.context: One row of the report for a reshape that stopped part way through, counting the columns write-phase step one had already written.

reshape.wrote.archived.text: संग्रहित किए गए हटाए जा रहे कॉलम: {count}।
reshape.wrote.archived.context: One row of the report for a reshape that stopped part way through, counting the retiring columns the archive step had already put into the archive.

reshape.wrote.carried.text: हटाए जा रहे कॉलम से ले जाए गए कार्ड: {count}।
reshape.wrote.carried.context: One row of the report for a reshape that stopped part way through, counting the cards the carry had already moved to their destinations.

reshape.wrote.updated.text: नई परिभाषा से फिर लिखे गए रखे हुए कॉलम: {count}।
reshape.wrote.updated.context: One row of the report for a reshape that stopped part way through, counting the kept columns whose anchor the rewrite had already changed.

reshape.wrote.withdrawn.text: हटाए जा रहे कॉलम के लिए वापस ली गई स्थायी मदें: {count}।
reshape.wrote.withdrawn.context: One row of the report for a reshape that stopped part way through, counting the standing items the withdrawal step had already withdrawn.

root.empty.text: {root} के नीचे कोई वर्कबेंच नहीं है
root.empty.context: The whole answer to a root-scoped read, and to dinah list workbenches given a path, that walked a real directory and found nothing. {root} is the directory walked. Finding nothing is an ordinary answer rather than a refusal, so the command exits 0 having printed this.

root.workbench.context: The heading printed above one workbench's own answer under a root-scoped read, which is dinah tree, status, ls, next or changes given --root. It names the workbench the lines below it belong to. {title} is the workbench's title, {slug} is its slug or the missing-slug repair, and {path} is its directory. The three are separated by single spaces because this is a label line rather than a table row: two of these printed one after another would otherwise read as a two-row table whose columns do not line up, which is a rendering defect the head's own output check catches.

root.workbench.refused.context: The heading printed in place of root.workbench for a workbench the walk could not read, which is followed by no answer at all. {path} is the directory, and {refusal} is the bracketed refusal name workbenches.refused composes. The path leads because it is the only identity a workbench nothing could read still has: no title and no slug were ever read off it.

root.workbench.unanswered.text: यह वर्कबेंच पढ़ी गई, और उसने उत्तर नहीं दिया: {refusal}
root.workbench.unanswered.context: The line printed under root.workbench for a workbench that opened and whose own read then refused, which is what naming a column one workbench has and another does not produces. {refusal} is the bracketed refusal name workbenches.refused composes. The sentence says the workbench read, because it did: what refused was the question asked of it rather than the directory, and root.workbench.refused is the heading for the other case.

root.workbench.unopened.context: The line printed under root.workbench for a workbench the walk described off its anchor and then could not open, so its title and its slug are known and nothing further about it is. {refusal} is the bracketed refusal name workbenches.refused composes. It follows the identity line rather than replacing it, because that identity was read, and a reader who loses it cannot tell which directory of the listing failed.

schema.basis.description.text: इस कार्ड के लिए पिछली प्रतिक्रिया ने जो संशोधन बताया था; यदि कार्ड उसके बाद आगे बढ़ चुका है तो कॉल को बासी मानकर अस्वीकार किया जाता है
schema.basis.description.context: The description of the basis property, which the eight generated machine schemas that consume basis carry and no command declares.

schema.harness.description.text: वह harness जिसके नीचे यह कॉल चल रहा है, छोटे अक्षरों वाला एक खंड; यदि कॉल कोई नहीं बताता तो सर्वर प्रक्रिया का अपना DINAH_HARNESS
schema.harness.description.context: The description of the harness property, which every generated machine schema carries and no command declares. A per-call value outranks the server process's environment member by member, which is what the second clause says.

schema.model.description.text: इस कॉल का मॉडल, उसी वर्तनी में जो प्रदाता देता है; यदि कॉल कोई नहीं बताता तो सर्वर प्रक्रिया का अपना DINAH_MODEL
schema.model.description.context: The description of the model property, which every generated machine schema carries and no command declares. The value is stamped on the journal under OpenTelemetry's gen_ai.request.model and is the other half of what the tiers table resolves a tier from.

schema.provider.description.text: इस कॉल के मॉडल को देने वाला प्रदाता; यदि कॉल कोई नहीं बताता तो सर्वर प्रक्रिया का अपना DINAH_PROVIDER
schema.provider.description.context: The description of the provider property, which every generated machine schema carries and no command declares. The value is stamped on the journal under OpenTelemetry's gen_ai.provider.name and is one half of what the workbench's tiers table resolves a tier from.

schema.server.description.text: वह पता जहाँ मॉडल तक पहुँचा गया, केवल तब भेजें जब प्रदाता का नाम उसे स्वयं नहीं बताता; यदि कॉल कोई नहीं बताता तो सर्वर प्रक्रिया का अपना DINAH_SERVER
schema.server.description.context: The description of the server property, which every generated machine schema carries and no command declares. The value is stamped on the journal under OpenTelemetry's server.address and lets a tiers table tell one model name on a laptop from the same name on a vendor's cloud.

schema.workbench.description.text: कार्यपीठ की अपनी भंडार निर्देशिका, पूर्ण पथ के रूप में; छोड़ देने पर सर्वर की तयशुदा कार्यपीठ
schema.workbench.description.context: The description of the workbench property, which every generated machine schema carries except the workbenches tool, and which an MCP caller sets to reach a workbench other than the one the server started with.

search.empty.text: किसी कार्ड, कॉलम, वर्कस्ट्रीम या वर्कबेंच के पाठ से उस खोज का मेल नहीं है।
search.empty.context: Printed when a search phrase matched nothing at all. The phrase itself was legal, so this is an answer rather than a refusal.

serve.listening.text: {workbench} को {url} पर परोसा जा रहा है
serve.listening.context: The one line dinah serve prints to stdout once it is listening. {workbench} is the absolute path of the workbench it serves and {url} is the address it listens on, such as http://127.0.0.1:7340/.

show.attachments.context: The label above a card's attachments, printed between the links block and the comments block.

show.checklist.context: The label above a card's checklist items, printed between the comments block and what a shaped answer held back.

show.collection.empty.context: Printed when `dinah show` is asked for a collection that has no members. No text follows and the call succeeds, because a collection holding nothing is an answer rather than a mistake. It reads as attachments.empty and contents.empty read, since the three commands are answering the same shape of question.

show.comments.context: The label above a card's comments.

show.links.context: The label above a card's links.

show.refilter.text: यह कार्ड उन सदस्यों में से अधिक रखता है जितना यह उत्तर लाया। {reread} को फिर पढ़ें, जो सदस्य चाहिए उन्हें --fields में नाम दें और {flags} हटा दें।
show.refilter.context: The sentence printed under show.withheld in place of show.reread when a filter narrowed the answer. Naming the member again would serve no more of it, because the caller has already named it and the flag is what dropped the rest, so this sentence names both levers. {reread} is the card's own reference and {flags} is the flag words the caller wrote. Those words and the flag spelling inside the sentence are syntax and stay as they are.

show.reread.text: यह कार्ड वे सदस्य रखता है। उन्हें पाने के लिए {reread} पर --fields में उनका नाम दें।
show.reread.context: The sentence printed under show.withheld, telling the reader how to be served a member that was held back. {reread} is the card's own reference. The flag spelling inside it is syntax and stays as it is.

show.withheld.context: The heading printed under a card whose answer was shaped by a field list, naming the members the card holds and this answer did not carry. {members} is that list of member names, which is machine vocabulary and is never translated.

slot.comment.context: Names comment's free-text slot inside refusal.dinah.multiple-words, which reads it as {label}.

slot.item.context: The label naming what a bare word after dinah file was meant to be, printed when several unquoted words arrive where one argument belongs.

slot.name.context: Names rename's free-text slot inside refusal.dinah.multiple-words, which reads it as {label}.

reason.deletedDesignation.text: जो टिप्पणी इसका अभिलेख उत्तर थी, वह हटा दी गई: {comment}.
reason.deletedDesignation.context: The reason a forced deletion composes for the reopen it performs. {comment} is the reference of the comment being deleted, which is the only part of it that survives.

slot.note.context: The label naming what a bare word after resolve, verify or fail was meant to be, printed when several unquoted words arrive where one argument belongs.

slot.query.context: Names query's free-text slot inside refusal.dinah.multiple-words, which reads it as {label}.

slot.reason.context: Names block's free-text slot inside refusal.dinah.multiple-words, which reads it as {label}.

slot.search.context: Names search's free-text slot inside refusal.dinah.multiple-words, which reads it as {label}.

slot.title.context: Names add's free-text slot inside refusal.dinah.multiple-words, which reads it as {label}.

slot.value.context: Names the free-text slot of `config set` and of `set` inside refusal.dinah.multiple-words, which reads it as {label}.

slug.missing.context: The placeholder a human-rendered listing shows in a slug column for a column or workbench carrying none, naming the repair rather than padding an empty string.

status.actor.context: The second line of status: who you are and whether you are the operator.

status.blocked.context: The label above the blocked cards.

status.holding.context: The label above the cards this actor holds.

status.workbench.context: The first line of status: the workbench, where it was discovered, and the rung (flag, environment, search, or config) that resolved it.

status.workbench.unsourced.context: The first line of status under a root-scoped read: the workbench and where it was discovered, with no rung named. It stands in for status.workbench, which also names the rung that resolved the workbench, because a root-scoped read resolves no single workbench by any rung and an empty bracket reads as a value that failed to render.

token.active.context: How the canonical token active is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.archived.context: How the canonical token archived is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.attached.context: How the canonical token attached is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.attachment.context: Names the text of an attachment, in the matched-in column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.attachment_removed.context: How the canonical token attachment_removed is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.attachment_renamed.context: How the canonical token attachment_renamed is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.attachment_replaced.context: How the canonical token attachment_replaced is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.backward.context: How the canonical token backward is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.blocked.context: How the canonical token blocked is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.card.context: Names a card, in the kind column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.claimed.context: How the canonical token claimed is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.column.context: Names a column, in the kind column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.comment.context: Names a comment, in the matched-in column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.commented.context: How the canonical token commented is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.config.context: How the canonical token config is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a setting resolved from in the settings listing. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.created.context: How the canonical token created is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.default.context: How the canonical token default is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a setting resolved from in the settings listing: nobody set this one, so the tool's own default answered. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.deleted.context: How the canonical token deleted is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.dinah-editor.context: How the canonical token dinah-editor is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a setting resolved from in the settings listing: the DINAH_EDITOR environment variable, which the editor ladder reads above everything else. The rendering is the variable's own name, the same convention token.visual uses for VISUAL, so the row names the variable that won rather than a flag the tool has none of. The same in every language.

token.done.context: How the canonical token done is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.environment.context: How the canonical token environment is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a setting resolved from in the settings listing: an environment variable carried the value. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.expired.context: How the canonical token expired is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.fallback.context: How the canonical token fallback is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a setting resolved from in the settings listing: every rung above it was unset, so the platform's own fallback answered. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.flag.context: How the canonical token flag is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a setting resolved from in the settings listing: a flag on this invocation. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.forward.context: How the canonical token forward is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.framing.context: Names framing prose, which is a card's body, the workbench's own body, a column's instructions or a workstream's notes, in the matched-in column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.intake.context: How the canonical token intake is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.locale.context: How the canonical token locale is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a setting resolved from in the settings listing: the operating system's locale answered, as a hint about the machine. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.manual_correction.context: How the canonical token manual_correction is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.moved.context: How the canonical token moved is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.ready.context: How the canonical token ready is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.reference.context: Names a card's own human reference, in the matched-in column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.released.context: How the canonical token released is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.renumbered.context: How the canonical token renumbered is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.restored.context: How the canonical token restored is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.search.context: How the canonical token search is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a workbench answer came from: the ancestor walk resolved it, in the settings listing and on the status line alike. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.tier_overridden.context: How the canonical token tier_overridden is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.tier_override_dropped.context: How the canonical token tier_override_dropped is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.title.context: Names a title, in the matched-in column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.unblocked.context: How the canonical token unblocked is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.unknown.context: How the canonical token unknown is rendered where a person reads it, marking a row of the settings listing whose key the tool does not know: the file carries it, the tool resolves nothing from it, and it survives every write. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.unset.context: How the canonical token unset is rendered where a person reads it, marking a row of the settings listing that no rung of its ladder answered. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.visual.context: How the canonical token visual is rendered where a person reads it, naming the rung a setting resolved from in the settings listing: the VISUAL environment variable, which the editor ladder reads above EDITOR. The rendering is the variable's own name, which is the same in every language.

token.work.context: How the canonical token work is rendered where a person reads it. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.workbench.context: Names the workbench itself, in the kind column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.workbench_updated.context: The word a person reads for the workbench_updated journal event.

token.workstream.context: Names a workstream, in the kind column of the table `dinah search` prints.

token.workstream_joined.context: The word a person reads for the workstream_joined journal event, which records a card entering a workstream.

token.workstream_left.context: The word a person reads for the workstream_left journal event, which records a card leaving a workstream.

token.workstream_updated.context: The word a person reads for the workstream_updated journal event.

tree.empty.context: Printed when a tree has no card in it at all, so nothing is drawn beneath the sentence above it.

tree.header.context: The sentence above the tree `dinah tree` prints, naming the workbench the tree was built from. {title} is the workbench's title, {ref} its slug, and {count} how many cards it holds. The table starts at this node's children, so no row repeats it.

tree.header.filtered.text: {title} ({ref}) में {held} कार्ड हैं, जिनमें से {matched} प्रश्न से मेल खाते हैं।
tree.header.filtered.context: The sentence above the tree `dinah tree` prints when a query narrowed it. {held} is how many cards the workbench holds and {matched} how many the query selected, so the two numbers are always the larger and then the smaller.

tree.hidden.depth.context: The Not shown cell on a node whose own children the depth did not draw. {count} is how many of its direct children were left out, which is not the same number as the subjects those children hold; the Count column beside it already carries those.

tree.hidden.filter.context: The Not shown cell on a node the query removed cards from. {count} is how many cards at or below this node the query left out.

tree.hidden.join.context: Joins the two halves of a Not shown cell on a node that is holding something back for both reasons at once. {first} is the depth's account and {second} the query's.

tree.unset.context: The label on the group holding the cards that carry no value at all on the axis. It is drawn in the Reference column, where every other group row carries the value it gathered at.

ui.no-browser.text: कोई ब्राउज़र नहीं खुल सका ({error})। {url} खुद खोलें।
ui.no-browser.context: Written to stderr by dinah ui when the platform would not open a browser; the server goes on serving. {error} is the operating system's own error text and {url} is the address the server printed.

version.catalogs.context: The label above the shipped locales and their coverage.

version.format.context: The storage format version the binary implements.

version.profile.context: The conformance claim, carrying a major and a minor number and no channel.

warn.inapplicable-value.text: {detail} के अंतर्गत संग्रहीत मान अब इस कार्ड पर लागू नहीं होता, और वह रखा गया है; यदि उसे हटाना हो तो dinah set से साफ़ करें
warn.inapplicable-value.context: A warning on a successful write to a gating field that leaves a value on the card under a level axis or a declared key whose applies_when condition no longer admits the card. {detail} is that axis or key, read off the workbench and never translated. The value is kept rather than cleared, and the command line inside the sentence is syntax and stays as it is.

warn.stale-prefix.text: उपसर्ग {detail} किसी मौजूदा स्लग को नहीं नामता; संख्या से कार्ड मिला
warn.stale-prefix.context: A warning on a card reference whose prefix is left over from a rename.

whoami.harness.context: The harness line dinah whoami prints, shown only where the caller declared one. It is a labelled line rather than a padded column, on the rule that every columnar line in this tool is laid out by the row renderer and no catalog entry composes columns of its own.

whoami.harness.malformed.context: The harness line dinah whoami prints where the declared value is outside the one-segment grammar. The value is still shown, because a person repairing a mistyped variable needs to see what it says, and the parenthesis is what tells them it is not being read as a harness.

whoami.model.context: The model line dinah whoami prints, shown only where the caller declared one.

whoami.provider.context: The provider line dinah whoami prints, shown only where the caller declared one.

whoami.server.context: The server line dinah whoami prints, shown only where the caller declared an address.

whoami.tier.context: The tier line dinah whoami prints, shown only where the workbench's tiers table resolves the declared provider and model to a rung.

word.no.context: A boolean rendered for a person.

word.yes.context: A boolean rendered for a person.

workbenches.empty.text: यहाँ से कोई वर्कबेंच पहुँच योग्य नहीं है
workbenches.empty.context: Printed by the workbenches command when the search reaches none.

workbenches.refused.context: The workbench cell of a listing row the walk could not describe, standing where the title would be. {refusal} is the refusal name, such as dinah.unreadable-workbench, which is machine vocabulary and is never translated. The angle brackets say the cell holds the reason a value is missing rather than the value.

workstream.line.context: The one line printed about a workstream after it is created or one of its fields is written. {ref} is what a person types to reach it, {status} is the value stored under status.

workstreams.empty.text: इस वर्कबेंच में कोई वर्कस्ट्रीम नहीं है
workstreams.empty.context: Printed by the workstream command when the workbench carries none, in place of an empty table.

refusal.dinah.invalid-alias.context: The sentence printed after refusal dinah.invalid-alias. {detail} is the exact alias setting key and {defect} is its stable validation token.

refusal.dinah.invalid-alias.next.text: उपनाम सेटिंग ठीक करें या उसे `dinah config set {detail}` से हटाएं।
refusal.dinah.invalid-alias.next.context: The next step for dinah.invalid-alias. {detail} is the exact alias setting key. The command spelling is machine vocabulary and is never translated.

refusal.dinah.alias-shadows-command.text: उपनाम {detail} घोषित कमांड {command} को ढक देगा।
refusal.dinah.alias-shadows-command.context: The sentence printed after refusal dinah.alias-shadows-command. {detail} is the alias setting key and {command} is the declared command its suffix collides with.

refusal.dinah.missing-alias-argument.text: उपनाम {detail} के लिए तर्क {argument} आवश्यक है।
refusal.dinah.missing-alias-argument.context: The sentence printed after refusal dinah.missing-alias-argument. {detail} is the alias name and {argument} is the missing placeholder token.

refusal.dinah.missing-alias-argument.nex.text: छूटा हुआ तर्क दें और कमांड फिर चलाएं।

token.invalid.context: How the canonical token invalid is rendered in the settings listing for a stored alias quarantined by validation. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

token.shadowed.context: How the canonical token shadowed is rendered in the settings listing for a stored alias whose name is now a declared command. The machine surface always carries the canonical spelling.

refusal.dinah.comment-body-diverged.text: टिप्पणी {detail} का पाठ अब उस डाइजेस्ट से मेल नहीं खाता जो Dinah ने उस पर दर्ज किया था, अर्थात Dinah के बाहर किसी वस्तु ने उसे संपादित किया है।
refusal.dinah.comment-body-diverged.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.comment-body-diverged, which every verb that writes a comment's anchor raises when the stored digest disagrees with the body it is about to replace. {detail} is the comment's reference. The sentence says an edit happened and says nothing about who made it or when, because the tool knows neither.

refusal.dinah.comment-body-diverged.next.text: पाठ को हाथ से पूर्ववत करें, जिसके लिए कोई कमांड नहीं चाहिए, अथवा `dinah accept-divergence {detail}` चलाएँ ताकि डिस्क पर जो है वही अभिलेख बन जाए।
refusal.dinah.comment-body-diverged.next.context: The next step of refusal.dinah.comment-body-diverged, spliced onto the sentence that just named the comment. The two routes differ in meaning rather than in convenience: restoring says the edit was a mistake, and accepting says the edited body is now what the record says.

refusal.dinah.not-a-designation.text: {detail} उस मद की टिप्पणी नहीं है जिसे आप निपटा रहे हैं।
refusal.dinah.not-a-designation.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.not-a-designation, which resolve, verify and fail raise when the reference they were handed is not a comment of the item being settled. {detail} is the reference as the caller typed it.

refusal.dinah.not-a-designation.next.text: उत्तर --text के साथ लिखें, अथवा उस मद की कोई टिप्पणी नामित करें; `dinah show <item>` बताता है कि वह कौन सी टिप्पणियाँ रखता है।
refusal.dinah.not-a-designation.next.context: The next step of refusal.dinah.not-a-designation, spliced onto the sentence that just named the reference. <item> stands for the item's own reference and is not translated.

refusal.dinah.not-designatable.text: टिप्पणी {detail} मद {item} का अभिलिखित उत्तर है, अतः उसे मिटाने से वह मद निपटा हुआ रह जाएगा और उसके पीछे कुछ नहीं होगा।
refusal.dinah.not-designatable.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.not-designatable, which delete raises over a comment a checklist item designates. {detail} is the comment's reference and {item} is the designation the item carries.

refusal.dinah.not-designatable.next.text: पहले मद को फिर से खोलें, जिससे पदनाम हट जाता है, अथवा मिटाने की क्रिया --force के साथ फिर चलाएँ, जो उसी क्रिया के अंग के रूप में मद को फिर से खोल देती है।
refusal.dinah.not-designatable.next.context: The next step of refusal.dinah.not-designatable, spliced onto the sentence that just named the comment and the item.

refusal.dinah.store-awaiting-migration.text: {detail} पर का कार्यक्षेत्र चेकलिस्ट आइटम का उत्तर ऐसे रूप में रखता है जिसे यह बिल्ड अब नहीं पढ़ता।
refusal.dinah.store-awaiting-migration.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.store-awaiting-migration, which every read of a workbench below the current format raises. {detail} is the workbench's own path. The refusal exists because a reader that carried on would report the store's answers wrongly rather than incompletely, which is a false reading rather than a degraded one.

refusal.dinah.store-awaiting-migration.n.text: बैकअप लें, फिर उस कार्यक्षेत्र पर `dinah check --migrate-designations` चलाएँ; जो उत्तर को अब भी नोट के रूप में रखता है उसे उससे पहले dinah-migrate-notes चाहिए।
refusal.dinah.store-awaiting-migration.n.context: The next step of refusal.dinah.store-awaiting-migration. dinah-migrate-notes is the migration program's own name and dinah check --migrate-designations is a command line; neither is translated, and the command line is the one invocation the sentence carries, so a reader following it types that and nothing else. The backup is named first because both migrations write in place and neither can undo itself.

check.comment-body-diverged.text: टिप्पणी {detail} का पाठ अब उस डाइजेस्ट से मेल नहीं खाता जो Dinah ने उस पर दर्ज किया था
check.comment-body-diverged.context: A check finding: a comment whose stored digest disagrees with its body, which means something outside Dinah edited it. It names no editor and no time, because the tool knows neither, and a comment carrying no digest is not reported at all.

check.empty-comment.text: टिप्पणी {detail} का पाठ रिक्त है और कोई उसे पदनामित नहीं करता, अतः उस पर `dinah delete` चलाएँ
check.empty-comment.context: A check finding at cleanup severity: an abandoned draft, which is what creating a comment before writing one costs. Nothing is blocked by it.

check.empty-designated-comment.text: टिप्पणी {detail} का पाठ रिक्त है और कोई चेकलिस्ट मद उसे अपने उत्तर के रूप में पदनामित करता है
check.empty-designated-comment.context: A check finding at defect severity: an item's answer of record cannot be nothing. It is the same emptiness check.empty-comment reports, and it is a defect rather than clutter because something depends on this one.

check.item-carries-retired-note.text: चेकलिस्ट मद {detail} अब भी सेवानिवृत्त नोट कुंजी रखता है
check.item-carries-retired-note.context: A check finding: an item the note migration reached and did not finish, which is the state an interrupted run leaves one item in. Running the migration again finishes it.

check.dangling-resolution.text: चेकलिस्ट मद {detail} ऐसी टिप्पणी पदनामित करता है जो अब हल नहीं होती
check.dangling-resolution.context: A check finding: a resolution naming a comment that is not there. Deleting a designated comment is refused and the forced form clears the designation, so this is the residue of a hand edit rather than of anything the tool did.

column.checklist.resolution.context: The heading of the column of the checklist block of `dinah show <card>` that carries the reference of the comment a settled item designates as its answer. One word, because the block is bounded by the reader's window.

show.designation.context: The line drawn under a settled checklist item's row by a full checklist read, carrying the designated comment's author, its timestamp and its text. {body} is already capped for display by the time it reaches here.

show.designation.unattributed.text: ऐसा लेखक जिसका नाम यह कार्यपीठ नहीं बता सकती, {ts} पर: {body}
show.designation.unattributed.context: The form show.designation takes for a comment whose author the store could not recover, which the note migration records as an absence rather than as a name. It says the store cannot name the author rather than leaving a blank that reads as a defect.

slot.designation.context: What the comment argument of resolve, verify and fail is called in the refusal a caller meets when they typed several bare words where one reference belongs.

param.designation.summary.text: इस मद की वह टिप्पणी जो उत्तर दर्ज करती है, उसके संदर्भ के रूप में लिखी जाती है; उत्तर को इसके बजाय --text से लिखें
param.designation.summary.context: The written meaning of the comment argument, shared by resolve, verify and fail. Naming a comment is how somebody endorses words another person wrote: the comment keeps its own author and the settling records who chose it.

param.designation-text.summary.text: उत्तर स्वयं, जो इस मद की टिप्पणी के रूप में लिखा जाता है और एक ही क्रिया में पदनामित होता है; अकेला - उसे पाइप से पढ़ता है
param.designation-text.summary.context: The written meaning of the --text flag, shared by resolve, verify and fail. It is the one-command form, and it cannot be named beside a designation reference, because the two are different acts.

param.delete.force.summary.text: ऐसी टिप्पणी मिटाएँ जिसे कोई चेकलिस्ट मद पदनामित करता है, और उसी क्रिया के अंग के रूप में उस मद को फिर से खोलें
param.delete.force.summary.context: The meaning of the force argument of `dinah delete`, printed in that command's arguments table. It is the operator's alone where the designating item is the operator's.

param.accept-divergence.comment.summary.text: वह टिप्पणी जिसके डिस्क पर स्थित पाठ को आप अभिलेख बना रहे हैं
param.accept-divergence.comment.summary.context: The meaning of the comment argument of `dinah accept-divergence`, printed in that command's arguments table.

cmd.accept-divergence.summary.text: किसी टिप्पणी के संपादित पाठ को अभिलेख बनाएँ
cmd.accept-divergence.summary.context: The one-line summary of the accept-divergence command, printed in the command list and above its own help.

reason.designated-comment-deleted.context: The reason a forced deletion composes for the reopen it performs, recorded in the journal. {comment} is the deleted comment's reference, which is the only part of it that survives.

param.set.expect-digest.summary.text: वह डाइजेस्ट जो आपने इस टिप्पणी पर अंतिम बार दर्ज देखा था; यदि उसके बाद किसी ने टिप्पणी लिखी है तो लेखन अस्वीकार होगा
param.set.expect-digest.summary.context: The meaning of the expect-digest argument of `dinah set`, printed in that command's arguments table. It is for a caller that had the comment open while its author typed: an editor writes the file on save, so the body the write would otherwise be compared against is gone, and the digest on the header is what is left to compare.

check.move.5.text: निवेदन किसी स्वामी को नामता है
check.move.5.context: One row of the ordered precondition list of move. This row is Dinah's own addition: the core profile's own section 6.3 table carries no row reading "the request names an owner" (only CORE-CLAIM and CORE-BLOCK's own tables do), so this key does not claim the profile's own wording the way the numbered rows above it do.

check.release.2.text: निवेदन किसी स्वामी को नामता है
check.release.2.context: One row of the ordered precondition list of release. This row is Dinah's own addition: the core profile's own section 6.5 table carries no row reading "the request names an owner" (only CORE-CLAIM and CORE-BLOCK's own tables do), so this key does not claim the profile's own wording the way the numbered rows above it do.

check.unblock.2.text: निवेदन किसी स्वामी को नामता है
check.unblock.2.context: One row of the ordered precondition list of unblock. This row is Dinah's own addition: the core profile's own section 6.6 table carries no row reading "the request names an owner" (only CORE-CLAIM and CORE-BLOCK's own tables do), so this key does not claim the profile's own wording the way the numbered rows above it do.

check.check.1.text: आपका बताया harness मान्य नाम है
check.check.1.context: One row of the ordered precondition list of check, run when the request carries at least one repair marker. check has no numbered table in the core profile, so this row carries Dinah's own wording rather than a quotation.

check.check.2.text: निवेदन किसी स्वामी को नामता है
check.check.2.context: One row of the ordered precondition list of check, run when the request carries at least one repair marker, immediately after the harness row above. check has no numbered table in the core profile, so this row carries Dinah's own wording rather than a quotation.

refusal.no-owner.next-harness.text: ; एक {harness} हार्नेस घोषित है, इसलिए आपकी सेटिंग्स में कॉन्फ़िगर किया गया actor, यदि कोई हो, यहाँ लागू नहीं होता; कौन कार्य कर रहा है यह बताने के लिए `dinah --actor <name>` चलाएँ या `DINAH_ACTOR` सेट करें
refusal.no-owner.next-harness.context: Spliced onto refusal.no-owner as the next step, in place of refusal.no-owner.next, when the request that raised the refusal declared a harness: the configuration rung of the actor ladder answers only a call declaring none, so a harness-declaring call is refused rather than promoted to whatever a shared config file carries.

status.actor.unnamed.text: इस प्रक्रिया के लिए कोई actor नामित नहीं है; कौन कार्य कर रहा है यह बताने के लिए `dinah config set actor <name>` चलाएँ या `DINAH_ACTOR` सेट करें
status.actor.unnamed.context: The second line of status when no actor resolved for this process, printed in place of status.actor so the line never interpolates an empty actor name.

card.route.context: Printed under the card line when the card walks a route the workbench declares. A card on the workbench's full column list draws no such line.

check.add.6.text: वर्कबेंच उस मार्ग को घोषित करती है जिसका आपने नाम लिया
check.add.6.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.add.7.text: मार्ग उस कॉलम को रखता है जिसमें आप दर्ज कर रहे हैं
check.add.7.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.card-off-route.text: {detail} ऐसे कॉलम में खड़ा है जिसे उसका अपना मार्ग नहीं रखता
check.card-off-route.context: A check finding: a card has been moved, rejected or re-routed onto a column its road does not carry. {detail} carries the card and the column, in that order. The card's forward move is the first route column after it, so this is worth a person's attention rather than broken.

check.card-unknown-route.text: {detail} ऐसे मार्ग का नाम लेता है जो यह वर्कबेंच घोषित नहीं करती
check.card-unknown-route.context: A check finding: a card's route names one the workbench declares. {detail} carries the card and the route name, in that order. The card walks the workbench's full column list meanwhile.

check.file.1.text: यह वर्कबेंच एक संचालक नियुक्त करती है
check.file.1.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.file.2.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.file.3.text: अनुरोध किसी स्वामी का नाम लेता है
check.file.3.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.file.4.text: अनुरोध किसी प्रकार का नाम लेता है
check.file.4.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.file.5.text: प्रकार चेकलिस्ट के तीन में से एक है
check.file.5.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.file.6.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.file.7.text: वर्कबेंच उस कॉलम को घोषित करती है जिसका आपने नाम लिया
check.file.7.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.file.8.text: कार्ड का मार्ग उस कॉलम को रखता है जिसका आपने नाम लिया
check.file.8.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.item-off-route.text: {detail} ऐसे कॉलम का नाम लेता है जिसे कार्ड का मार्ग नहीं रखता, इसलिए उसकी रोक कभी लागू नहीं होगी
check.item-off-route.context: A check finding: a pending checklist item names a column the card will never stand at. {detail} carries the card, the item and the column, in that order.

check.route-duplicate-column.text: {detail} एक ही कॉलम का नाम दो बार लेता है
check.route-duplicate-column.context: A check finding: a route names each column once. {detail} carries the route name and the column, in that order.

check.route-empty.text: मार्ग {detail} इस वर्कबेंच का कोई कॉलम नहीं रखता
check.route-empty.context: A check finding: a route has to carry at least one column to be a road at all. {detail} carries the route name. A retirement that took a route's last column away produces it as well as a declaration that named none.

check.route-missing-first-column.text: {detail} वर्कबेंच का पहला कॉलम नहीं रखता, इसलिए कोई कार्ड उस पर वर्कबेंच में प्रवेश नहीं कर सकता
check.route-missing-first-column.context: A check finding: cards enter a workbench at its first column, which is where dinah add files one, so a route without it has no door. {detail} carries the route name and that first column, in that order.

check.route-missing-terminal.text: {detail} ऐसे कॉलम पर समाप्त होता है जो समाप्ति कॉलम नहीं है, इसलिए उस पर कोई कार्ड पूरा नहीं हो सकता
check.route-missing-terminal.context: A check finding: a route ends in the terminal region. {detail} carries the route name and the column it ends at, in that order.

check.route-name-malformed.text: मार्ग {detail} का नाम मार्ग नामों के व्याकरण से बाहर है
check.route-name-malformed.context: A check finding: a route name has to read as a slug, because it is typed on a command line and read back out of a refusal. {detail} carries the name, and the repair is an edit to the workbench's own routes block.

check.route-out-of-order.text: मार्ग {detail} अपने कॉलम प्रवाह के अपने क्रम से भिन्न क्रम में सूचीबद्ध करता है
check.route-out-of-order.context: A check finding: a route resolves in flow order whatever order it was written in, so this says the file does not read the way it runs. {detail} carries the route name.

check.route-reject-target-off-route.text: {detail} reject_to में ऐसा कॉलम बताता है जो यह मार्ग नहीं रखता
check.route-reject-target-off-route.context: A check finding: a push-back on a route should land on that route. {detail} carries the route name, the declaring column and the target, in that order. The card still lands there by an ordinary move and walks forward into its route again, so this is worth knowing rather than broken.

check.route-unknown-column.text: {detail} ऐसे कॉलम का नाम लेता है जो यह वर्कबेंच घोषित नहीं करती
check.route-unknown-column.context: A check finding: every identifier a route names is a column of the flow. {detail} carries the route name and the identifier, in that order, and the repair is an edit to the workbench's own routes block.

check.set.10.text: मार्ग कार्ड से आगे के हर संचालक-आरक्षित कॉलम को रखता है
check.set.10.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

check.set.9.text: कोई लंबित मद ऐसे कॉलम का नाम नहीं लेती जिसे मार्ग छोड़ देता है
check.set.9.context: One row of the precondition list of a command outside the five the profile specifies.

column.moves.route.context: Heading over whether this row is the forward move along the card's own route, in the legal moves printed under a served instruction. A column heading, which a reader has to be able to tell from the rows beneath it by its own text as well as by the rule under it.

column.routes.columns.context: Heading over how many live columns a route carries, in the listing dinah list routes prints. A column heading, which a reader has to be able to tell from the rows beneath it by its own text as well as by the rule under it.

column.routes.route.context: Heading over a route's own name, in the listing dinah list routes prints. A column heading, which a reader has to be able to tell from the rows beneath it by its own text as well as by the rule under it.

column.routes.skips.context: Heading over the live columns a route omits, in the listing dinah list routes prints. A column heading, which a reader has to be able to tell from the rows beneath it by its own text as well as by the rule under it.

lsp.completion.route.detail.text: मार्ग जो प्रवाह के {columns} कॉलम रखता है
lsp.completion.route.detail.context: The detail line beside one route candidate in a completion list. {columns} is how many live columns that route carries, which is the one fact that says how short the road is without opening the block.

param.add.route.summary.text: कार्ड किस मार्ग पर दर्ज करना है, उन मार्गों में से जो यह वर्कबेंच घोषित करती है; यदि आप कोई नहीं बताते तो पूरी कॉलम सूची
param.add.route.summary.context: The meaning of the route argument of `dinah add`, printed in that command's arguments table.

refusal.dinah.item-off-route.text: मार्ग {route} {detail} को नहीं रखता, इसलिए उस कॉलम का नाम लेने वाली मद इस कार्ड को कहीं नहीं रोकेगी।
refusal.dinah.item-off-route.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.item-off-route, which filing an item against a column the card's own route drops carries. {detail} is the column that was named and {route} is the route the card walks.

refusal.dinah.item-off-route.next.text: ऐसे कॉलम का नाम दें जिसे मार्ग रखता हो, या पहले कार्ड का मार्ग बदलें।
refusal.dinah.item-off-route.next.context: The next step of refusal.dinah.item-off-route, which names the two repairs open to the caller.

refusal.dinah.route-off-column.text: मार्ग {route} {detail} को नहीं रखता, इसलिए वहाँ दर्ज किया गया कार्ड शुरू से ही अपने मार्ग से बाहर खड़ा होगा।
refusal.dinah.route-off-column.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.route-off-column, which a filing whose destination column the named route drops carries. {detail} is the column the card would have landed in and {route} is the route that was named.

refusal.dinah.route-off-column.next.text: कार्ड को मार्ग के किसी कॉलम में दर्ज करें, या कोई दूसरा मार्ग चुनें।
refusal.dinah.route-off-column.next.context: The next step of refusal.dinah.route-off-column, which names the two repairs open to the caller.

refusal.dinah.route-skips-operator-colum.text: मार्ग {detail} {column} को नहीं रखता, जिसे यह कार्ड अभी पार नहीं कर पाया है और जिसे यह वर्कबेंच अपने संचालक के लिए सुरक्षित रखती है।
refusal.dinah.route-skips-operator-colum.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.route-skips-operator-column, which a route write whose route omits an operator-owned station the card has not reached carries. {detail} is the route name that was written and {column} is the station it omits.
